1	"""Schema model: object types plus the @entity / @link mapping directives.
2	
3	Mapping declaration problems (missing or conflicting entity/directive
4	declarations, dangling type references) raise PlanError "MappingError".
5	"""
6	
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
10	
11	from .errors import PlanError
12	from .gql import Directive, TypeRef, parse_schema_document
13	
14	BUILTIN_SCALARS = frozenset({"Int", "Float", "String", "Boolean", "ID"})
15	
16	
17	def named_of(type_ref: TypeRef) -> str:
18	    """Unwrap list/non-null wrappers down to the named type."""
19	    while type_ref[0] in ("list", "non_null"):
20	        type_ref = type_ref[1]
21	    return type_ref[1]
22	
23	
24	class Entity:
25	    __slots__ = ("type_name", "table", "key")
26	
27	    def __init__(self, type_name: str, table: str, key: List[str]):
28	        self.type_name = type_name
29	        self.table = table
30	        self.key = key  # primary key field names, in declared order
31	
32	
33	class FieldInfo:
34	    __slots__ = ("name", "type_ref", "args", "link_directives", "link")
35	
36	    def __init__(self, name, type_ref, args, link_directives):
37	        self.name = name
38	        self.type_ref = type_ref
39	        self.args = args  # Dict[str, InputValueDef]
40	        self.link_directives = link_directives
41	        # (local names, target names, declared_as_arrays) once validated
42	        self.link: Optional[Tuple[List[str], List[str], bool]] = None
43	
44	
45	class TypeInfo:
46	    __slots__ = ("name", "fields", "interfaces", "entity")
47	
48	    def __init__(self, name: str, interfaces: List[str]):
49	        self.name = name
50	        self.fields: Dict[str, FieldInfo] = {}
51	        self.interfaces = interfaces
52	        self.entity: Optional[Entity] = None
53	
54	
55	class Schema:
56	    def __init__(self):
57	        self.types: Dict[str, TypeInfo] = {}
58	        self.scalars = set(BUILTIN_SCALARS)
59	        self.enums = set()
60	        self.inputs: Dict[str, Dict[str, object]] = {}
61	        self.interfaces = set()
62	        self.unions: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
63	        self.roots: Dict[str, str] = {}  # "query" | "mutation" | "subscription" -> type name
64	
65	    def is_leaf(self, type_name: str) -> bool:
66	        return type_name in self.scalars or type_name in self.enums
67	
68	    def known_type(self, type_name: str) -> bool:
69	        return (
70	            type_name in self.scalars
71	            or type_name in self.enums
72	            or type_name in self.types
73	            or type_name in self.inputs
74	            or type_name in self.interfaces
75	            or type_name in self.unions
76	        )
77	
78	
79	def _mapping_error(message: str) -> PlanError:
80	    return PlanError("MappingError", message)
81	
82	
83	def load_schema(text: str, source: str = "<schema>") -> Schema:
84	    doc = parse_schema_document(text, source)
85	    schema = Schema()
86	    schema.scalars |= set(doc.scalars)
87	    schema.enums = set(doc.enums)
88	    schema.interfaces = {tdef.name for tdef in doc.interfaces}
89	    schema.unions = dict(doc.unions)
90	
91	    for input_def in doc.inputs:
92	        if input_def.name in schema.inputs:
93	            raise _mapping_error(f"duplicate input type '{input_def.name}'")
94	        fields: Dict[str, object] = {}
95	        for fdef in input_def.fields:
96	            if fdef.name in fields:
97	                raise _mapping_error(
98	                    f"duplicate field '{fdef.name}' on input '{input_def.name}'"
99	                )
100	            fields[fdef.name] = fdef
101	        schema.inputs[input_def.name] = fields
102	
103	    # Merge plain definitions with `extend type` blocks.
104	    slots: Dict[str, dict] = {}
105	    for tdef in doc.types:
106	        slot = slots.setdefault(
107	            tdef.name, {"fields": [], "directives": [], "interfaces": [], "defined": False}
108	        )
109	        if not tdef.is_extend:
110	            if slot["defined"]:
111	                raise _mapping_error(f"duplicate definition of type '{tdef.name}'")
112	            slot["defined"] = True
113	        slot["fields"].extend(tdef.fields)
114	        slot["directives"].extend(tdef.directives)
115	        for iface in tdef.interfaces:
116	            if iface not in slot["interfaces"]:
117	                slot["interfaces"].append(iface)
118	
119	    reserved = set(schema.scalars) | schema.enums | set(schema.inputs) | schema.interfaces | set(schema.unions)
120	    for name in slots:
121	        if name in reserved:
122	            raise _mapping_error(f"name '{name}' is defined more than once")
123	
124	    for name, slot in slots.items():
125	        info = TypeInfo(name, slot["interfaces"])
126	        for iface in slot["interfaces"]:
127	            if iface not in schema.interfaces:
128	                raise _mapping_error(f"type '{name}' implements unknown interface '{iface}'")
129	        for fdef in slot["fields"]:
130	            if fdef.name in info.fields:
131	                raise _mapping_error(f"duplicate field '{fdef.name}' on type '{name}'")
132	            args: Dict[str, object] = {}
133	            for adef in fdef.args:
134	                if adef.name in args:
135	                    raise _mapping_error(
136	                        f"duplicate argument '{adef.name}' on '{name}.{fdef.name}'"
137	                    )
138	                args[adef.name] = adef
139	            link_directives = [d for d in fdef.directives if d.name == "link"]
140	            info.fields[fdef.name] = FieldInfo(fdef.name, fdef.type, args, link_directives)
141	        entity_directives = [d for d in slot["directives"] if d.name == "entity"]
142	        if len(entity_directives) > 1:
143	            raise _mapping_error(f"type '{name}' has multiple @entity directives")
144	        if entity_directives:
145	            info.entity = _build_entity(schema, info, entity_directives[0])
146	        schema.types[name] = info
147	
148	    _validate_type_references(schema)
149	    _validate_links(schema)
150	    _validate_entity_tables(schema)
151	    _resolve_roots(schema, doc.roots)
152	    return schema
153	
154	
155	def _normalize_field_list(value, what: str) -> Tuple[List[str], bool]:
156	    """Normalize a string-or-string-array directive argument.
157	
158	    Returns (field names in declared order, declared_as_array). Anything
159	    else (empty arrays, non-string elements, duplicates, other types) is a
160	    MappingError.
161	    """
162	    if isinstance(value, str):
163	        if not value:
164	            raise _mapping_error(f"{what} requires a non-empty string")
165	        return [value], False
166	    if isinstance(value, list):
167	        if not value:
168	            raise _mapping_error(f"{what} must not be an empty array")
169	        names: List[str] = []
170	        for item in value:
171	            if not isinstance(item, str) or not item:
172	                raise _mapping_error(f"{what} must contain only non-empty strings")
173	            if item in names:
174	                raise _mapping_error(f"{what} contains duplicate field '{item}'")
175	            names.append(item)
176	        return names, True
177	    raise _mapping_error(f"{what} must be a string or an array of strings")
178	
179	
180	def _build_entity(schema: Schema, info: TypeInfo, directive: Directive) -> Entity:
181	    table = directive.args.get("name")
182	    if not isinstance(table, str) or not table:
183	        raise _mapping_error(f"@entity on '{info.name}' requires a non-empty string 'name'")
184	    key, _ = _normalize_field_list(
185	        directive.args.get("key"), f"@entity 'key' of type '{info.name}'"
186	    )
187	    for name in key:
188	        key_field = info.fields.get(name)
189	        if key_field is None:
190	            raise _mapping_error(f"@entity key '{name}' is not a field of type '{info.name}'")
191	        if named_of(key_field.type_ref) not in schema.scalars:
192	            raise _mapping_error(f"@entity key '{name}' of type '{info.name}' must be a scalar")
193	    return Entity(info.name, table, key)
194	
195	
196	def _validate_type_references(schema: Schema) -> None:
197	    def check(type_ref: TypeRef, where: str) -> None:
198	        name = named_of(type_ref)
199	        if not schema.known_type(name):
200	            raise _mapping_error(f"unknown type '{name}' referenced by {where}")
201	
202	    for info in schema.types.values():
203	        for field in info.fields.values():
204	            check(field.type_ref, f"'{info.name}.{field.name}'")
205	            for arg in field.args.values():
206	                check(arg.type, f"argument '{arg.name}' of '{info.name}.{field.name}'")
207	    for input_name, fields in schema.inputs.items():
208	        for fdef in fields.values():
209	            check(fdef.type, f"input field '{input_name}.{fdef.name}'")
210	    for union_name, members in schema.unions.items():
211	        for member in members:
212	            if member not in schema.types:
213	                raise _mapping_error(f"union '{union_name}' references unknown type '{member}'")
214	
215	
216	def _validate_links(schema: Schema) -> None:
217	    for info in schema.types.values():
218	        for field in info.fields.values():
219	            directives = field.link_directives
220	            if len(directives) > 1:
221	                raise _mapping_error(f"field '{info.name}.{field.name}' has multiple @link directives")
222	            if not directives:
223	                continue
224	            directive = directives[0]
225	            where = f"@link on '{info.name}.{field.name}'"
226	            local, local_is_array = _normalize_field_list(
227	                directive.args.get("local"), f"{where} argument 'local'"
228	            )
229	            target, target_is_array = _normalize_field_list(
230	                directive.args.get("target"), f"{where} argument 'target'"
231	            )
232	            if local_is_array != target_is_array:
233	                raise _mapping_error(
234	                    f"{where} must use the same form (string or array) for 'local' and 'target'"
235	                )
236	            if len(local) != len(target):
237	                raise _mapping_error(
238	                    f"{where} has {len(local)} local field(s) but {len(target)} target field(s)"
239	                )
240	            target_type = named_of(field.type_ref)
241	            target_info = schema.types.get(target_type)
242	            if target_info is None:
243	                raise _mapping_error(
244	                    f"@link on '{info.name}.{field.name}' must point to an object type"
245	                )
246	            for name in local:
247	                local_field = info.fields.get(name)
248	                if local_field is None:
249	                    raise _mapping_error(
250	                        f"@link local field '{name}' is not a field of type '{info.name}'"
251	                    )
252	                if named_of(local_field.type_ref) not in schema.scalars:
253	                    raise _mapping_error(
254	                        f"@link local field '{name}' of type '{info.name}' must be a scalar"
255	                    )
256	            for name in target:
257	                if name not in target_info.fields:
258	                    raise _mapping_error(
259	                        f"@link target field '{name}' is not a field of type '{target_type}'"
260	                    )
261	            field.link = (local, target, local_is_array)
262	
263	
264	def _validate_entity_tables(schema: Schema) -> None:
265	    tables: Dict[str, str] = {}
266	    for info in schema.types.values():
267	        if info.entity is None:
268	            continue
269	        other = tables.get(info.entity.table)
270	        if other is not None:
271	            raise _mapping_error(
272	                f"entity '{info.entity.table}' is mapped by both '{other}' and '{info.name}'"
273	            )
274	        tables[info.entity.table] = info.name
275	
276	
277	def _resolve_roots(schema: Schema, declared: Dict[str, str]) -> None:
278	    for op, default_name in (("query", "Query"), ("mutation", "Mutation"), ("subscription", "Subscription")):
279	        if default_name in schema.types:
280	            schema.roots[op] = default_name
281	    for op, type_name in declared.items():
282	        if type_name not in schema.types:
283	            raise _mapping_error(f"root type '{type_name}' for {op} is not defined")
284	        schema.roots[op] = type_name

1	# Graph Index
2	
3	区块链数据索引与 GraphQL 查询服务：实体映射、订阅推送与查询计划。
4	
5	## 范围
6	
7	本仓库从零开始实现上述方向的可用工具，不依赖外部同类实现。
8	
9	## 状态
10	
11	- `graph-index query-plan`：将 GraphQL 查询编译为实体扫描/连接计划。
12	- `graph-index subscription-push --schema <schema.graphql> --subscription <subscription.graphql> --variables <variables.json> --events <events.ndjson> [--operation <name>]`：将订阅编译为实体等值过滤与字段投影（支持叶字段以及经 @link 到达的一层或多层嵌套对象字段与嵌套列表字段，含别名与片段展开），按序匹配 NDJSON 实体变更事件（INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE）。处理时先逐行解析校验，再按实体主键维护各实体最新快照（INSERT/UPDATE 保存 after，DELETE 删除 before 对应实体）；对象字段按 @link 的 local→target 顺序从截至当前行的最新目标快照取单个对象，任一 local 为 null 时关系为 null（非空对象字段则以 EventError 结束）；列表字段将目标表当前快照中 target 值与源 local 值等值匹配的实体全部收集，按目标首次 INSERT/UPDATE 入库的顺序排列（UPDATE 原位替换，DELETE 后重新 INSERT 排到末尾），任一 local 为 null 或无匹配时输出空数组，列表 @link 的 target 不必是目标实体主键（但 local/target 字段均须为标量）。成功时向 stdout 输出 JSONL（字段：`subscription`、`path`、`event`、`entity`、`data`），失败时向 stderr 输出 `{code, message}` 并以退出码 2 结束（stdout 不输出部分结果）。
13	- `graph-index query-exec --schema <schema.graphql> --query <query.graphql> --variables <variables.json> --events <events.ndjson> [--operation <name>]`：对实体变更快照直接执行一次 GraphQL 查询。事件先逐行解析校验，再按 INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE 顺序维护各查询可达实体的主键当前快照（INSERT/UPDATE 保存 after，DELETE 按 before 移除）；只执行 query，mutation/subscription 以 `UnsupportedOperation` 结束。根参数按映射实体标量字段等值过滤：列表根返回全部匹配行（快照首次入库顺序，UPDATE 原位替换，DELETE 后重插排末尾），单实体根零匹配返回 `null`、多匹配以 `QueryError` 结束。单对象 @link 的 local 按声明顺序指向目标实体主键：任一 local 为 null 时关系为 null（字段非空则 `EventError`），local 非 null 而目标不存在亦为 `EventError`；列表 @link 以 local 与 target 标量值等值匹配（target 无须是主键），无匹配或 local 含 null 返回空数组，并按目标首次入库顺序排列。别名、变量默认值、片段展开与复合主键沿用 query-plan 语义。事件结构、op、before/after、实体主键或投影快照（含字段值与 schema 声明形状不兼容）不合约定以 `EventError` 结束；GraphQL、变量、映射与连接声明的非法输入沿用既有错误码。成功时向 stdout 输出一次 GraphQL 响应（顶层 `data`），失败时向 stderr 输出单个 `{code, message}` 并以退出码 2 结束（stdout 无部分结果）。
14	
15	## 查询复杂度控制
16	
17	通过环境变量 `GRAPHQL_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT` 在服务启动时开启：变量缺省或值为 `0` 时功能关闭；值为正整数时为单次 operation 的最大复杂度；负数、非整数或无法解析的值使启动失败（不执行任何命令），向 stderr 输出 `{code: "INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT", message}` 并以退出码 2 结束。
18	
19	复杂度在真正执行解析器、读取索引实体或建立订阅之前，按同一份 GraphQL 文档与变量、对请求选定的单个 operation 计算（未选中的 operation 不计入）：
20	
21	- 从 operation 根 selection set 开始；每个叶子字段计 1，组合字段只累计其子 selection（对象容器自身计 0）；
22	- 重复字段与不同 alias 分别计分（即便执行阶段按 response key 合并，复杂度仍按原始选择逐个计）；
23	- fragment 在展开位置计入一次（同一 fragment 展开两处即计两处），inline fragment 直接计入其选择；类型条件不匹配当前类型的片段计 0；
24	- 内省字段 `__schema`、`__type` 计 0；
25	- 列表字段按有效条目上界放大其子 selection：优先读取字段参数 `first`，其次 `limit` 的正整数面值，也接受对应变量（含变量默认值）的正整数值；参数缺失、值非正或非整数时按 `1000` 计。变量本身的 GraphQL 类型校验仍由既有校验阶段负责（类型不符仍为 `VariablesError`）。嵌套列表的上界逐层相乘。
26	
27	判定确定：复杂度等于上限时允许执行并沿用既有查询路径、数据结构与顺序；严格大于上限时不调用解析器、不读取索引实体（query-exec 不再折叠事件）、不建立订阅（subscription-push 不产生任何推送），也没有持久化副作用。此时 query-exec 在 stdout 输出一次 GraphQL 响应、退出码 0：`data` 为 `null`，`errors` 恰有一个，其 `extensions.code` 为 `QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED`；subscription-push 以同一 GraphQL 响应代替 JSONL 输出。查询计划产生的分批取数不重复计费，订阅建立后推送的数据也不再次计费。
28	
29	畸形文档、变量类型错误、未知字段或 fragment 循环继续返回既有 GraphQL 校验错误（如 `ParseError`/`VariablesError`/`UnknownField`/`InvalidQuery`），不会被改写为复杂度错误；这些校验先于复杂度判定。`first`/`limit` 参数仅在复杂度控制开启、且字段为列表类型时被接受（不计入实体过滤）；功能关闭时仍按原规则报未知/不支持参数。`query-plan` 子命令不实施复杂度控制。
30	
31	## 约定
32	
33	- 公开行为以 README 与源码为准。
34	- 后续需求在此基线上增量实现。
35	- `@entity` 的 `key` 接收字符串或字符串数组（复合主键，如 `key: ["chain_id", "id"]`）；`@link` 的 `local` 与 `target` 同样各接收字符串或等长字符串数组。复合 key/local/target 均为非空且元素互不相同的字符串数组；空数组、重复元素、缺失字段、非标量字段、混合参数形式或数量不一致均以 `MappingError` 结束。复合连接在计划中以单条 join 输出，`fromField`/`toField` 为按声明顺序排列的字段数组；单字段 `@link` 仍输出字符串字段名。`@link` 的 `target` 未按顺序完整指向目标实体主键时以 `InvalidJoin` 结束（query-plan 与 subscription-push 的单对象关系均如此）；subscription-push 的列表关系改为等值匹配，target 可以不是主键，只要求对应字段存在且为标量。
36

# Graph Index

区块链数据索引与 GraphQL 查询服务：实体映射、订阅推送与查询计划。

## 范围

本仓库从零开始实现上述方向的可用工具，不依赖外部同类实现。

## 状态

- `graph-index query-plan`：将 GraphQL 查询编译为实体扫描/连接计划。
- `graph-index subscription-push --schema <schema.graphql> --subscription <subscription.graphql> --variables <variables.json> --events <events.ndjson> [--operation <name>]`：将订阅编译为实体等值过滤与字段投影（支持叶字段以及经 @link 到达的一层或多层嵌套对象字段与嵌套列表字段，含别名与片段展开），按序匹配 NDJSON 实体变更事件（INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE）。处理时先逐行解析校验，再按实体主键维护各实体最新快照（INSERT/UPDATE 保存 after，DELETE 删除 before 对应实体）；对象字段按 @link 的 local→target 顺序从截至当前行的最新目标快照取单个对象，任一 local 为 null 时关系为 null（非空对象字段则以 EventError 结束）；列表字段将目标表当前快照中 target 值与源 local 值等值匹配的实体全部收集，按目标首次 INSERT/UPDATE 入库的顺序排列（UPDATE 原位替换，DELETE 后重新 INSERT 排到末尾），任一 local 为 null 或无匹配时输出空数组，列表 @link 的 target 不必是目标实体主键（但 local/target 字段均须为标量）。成功时向 stdout 输出 JSONL（字段：`subscription`、`path`、`event`、`entity`、`data`），失败时向 stderr 输出 `{code, message}` 并以退出码 2 结束（stdout 不输出部分结果）。
- `graph-index query-exec --schema <schema.graphql> --query <query.graphql> --variables <variables.json> --events <events.ndjson> [--operation <name>]`：对实体变更快照直接执行一次 GraphQL 查询。事件先逐行解析校验，再按 INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE 顺序维护各查询可达实体的主键当前快照（INSERT/UPDATE 保存 after，DELETE 按 before 移除）；只执行 query，mutation/subscription 以 `UnsupportedOperation` 结束。根参数按映射实体标量字段等值过滤：列表根返回全部匹配行（快照首次入库顺序，UPDATE 原位替换，DELETE 后重插排末尾），单实体根零匹配返回 `null`、多匹配以 `QueryError` 结束。单对象 @link 的 local 按声明顺序指向目标实体主键：任一 local 为 null 时关系为 null（字段非空则 `EventError`），local 非 null 而目标不存在亦为 `EventError`；列表 @link 以 local 与 target 标量值等值匹配（target 无须是主键），无匹配或 local 含 null 返回空数组，并按目标首次入库顺序排列。别名、变量默认值、片段展开与复合主键沿用 query-plan 语义。事件结构、op、before/after、实体主键或投影快照（含字段值与 schema 声明形状不兼容）不合约定以 `EventError` 结束；GraphQL、变量、映射与连接声明的非法输入沿用既有错误码。成功时向 stdout 输出一次 GraphQL 响应（顶层 `data`），失败时向 stderr 输出单个 `{code, message}` 并以退出码 2 结束（stdout 无部分结果）。

## 查询复杂度控制

通过环境变量 `GRAPHQL_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT` 在服务启动时开启：变量缺省或值为 `0` 时功能关闭；值为正整数时为单次 operation 的最大复杂度；负数、非整数或无法解析的值使启动失败（不执行任何命令），向 stderr 输出 `{code: "INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT", message}` 并以退出码 2 结束。

复杂度在真正执行解析器、读取索引实体或建立订阅之前，按同一份 GraphQL 文档与变量、对请求选定的单个 operation 计算（未选中的 operation 不计入）：

- 从 operation 根 selection set 开始；每个叶子字段计 1，组合字段只累计其子 selection（对象容器自身计 0）；
- 重复字段与不同 alias 分别计分（即便执行阶段按 response key 合并，复杂度仍按原始选择逐个计）；
- fragment 在展开位置计入一次（同一 fragment 展开两处即计两处），inline fragment 直接计入其选择；类型条件不匹配当前类型的片段计 0；
- 内省字段 `__schema`、`__type` 计 0；
- 列表字段按有效条目上界放大其子 selection：优先读取字段参数 `first`，其次 `limit` 的正整数面值，也接受对应变量（含变量默认值）的正整数值；参数缺失、值非正或非整数时按 `1000` 计。变量本身的 GraphQL 类型校验仍由既有校验阶段负责（类型不符仍为 `VariablesError`）。嵌套列表的上界逐层相乘。

判定确定：复杂度等于上限时允许执行并沿用既有查询路径、数据结构与顺序；严格大于上限时不调用解析器、不读取索引实体（query-exec 不再折叠事件）、不建立订阅（subscription-push 不产生任何推送），也没有持久化副作用。此时 query-exec 在 stdout 输出一次 GraphQL 响应、退出码 0：`data` 为 `null`，`errors` 恰有一个，其 `extensions.code` 为 `QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED`；subscription-push 以同一 GraphQL 响应代替 JSONL 输出。查询计划产生的分批取数不重复计费，订阅建立后推送的数据也不再次计费。

畸形文档、变量类型错误、未知字段或 fragment 循环继续返回既有 GraphQL 校验错误（如 `ParseError`/`VariablesError`/`UnknownField`/`InvalidQuery`），不会被改写为复杂度错误；这些校验先于复杂度判定。`first`/`limit` 参数仅在复杂度控制开启、且字段为列表类型时被接受（不计入实体过滤）；功能关闭时仍按原规则报未知/不支持参数。`query-plan` 子命令不实施复杂度控制。

## 约定

- 公开行为以 README 与源码为准。
- 后续需求在此基线上增量实现。
- `@entity` 的 `key` 接收字符串或字符串数组（复合主键，如 `key: ["chain_id", "id"]`）；`@link` 的 `local` 与 `target` 同样各接收字符串或等长字符串数组。复合 key/local/target 均为非空且元素互不相同的字符串数组；空数组、重复元素、缺失字段、非标量字段、混合参数形式或数量不一致均以 `MappingError` 结束。复合连接在计划中以单条 join 输出，`fromField`/`toField` 为按声明顺序排列的字段数组；单字段 `@link` 仍输出字符串字段名。`@link` 的 `target` 未按顺序完整指向目标实体主键时以 `InvalidJoin` 结束（query-plan 与 subscription-push 的单对象关系均如此）；subscription-push 的列表关系改为等值匹配，target 可以不是主键，只要求对应字段存在且为标量。

lastPrompt: 当前基线已经能从实体变更事件执行 GraphQL 实体查询，复杂度控制已经认识 __schema 和 __type，但 query-exec 还没有真正公开类型系统元数据。本次我在保留 query-plan、subscription-push 的既有行为和所有既有错误码的前提下，为 query-exec 补全 GraphQL introspection，并允许对象选择集中使用 __typename…

1	"""Self-contained GraphQL lexer and parser.
2	
3	Parses both schema definition documents (SDL) and executable documents
4	(operations, fragments) into small dataclass ASTs. Syntax problems raise
5	PlanError with code "ParseError".
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import re
11	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
12	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
13	
14	from .errors import PlanError
15	
16	PUNCTUATORS = set("!$():=@[]{|}&")
17	NUMBER_RE = re.compile(r"-?(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\.[0-9]+)?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?")
18	
19	# Type references are nested tuples: ("named", name) | ("list", ref) | ("non_null", ref).
20	TypeRef = Tuple
21	
22	
23	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
24	# AST nodes
25	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
26	
27	
28	@dataclass
29	class Var:
30	    name: str
31	
32	
33	@dataclass
34	class Directive:
35	    name: str
36	    args: Dict[str, Any]
37	
38	
39	@dataclass
40	class InputValueDef:
41	    name: str
42	    type: TypeRef
43	    default: Any = None
44	    has_default: bool = False
45	
46	
47	@dataclass
48	class FieldDef:
49	    name: str
50	    args: List[InputValueDef]
51	    type: TypeRef
52	    directives: List[Directive]
53	
54	
55	@dataclass
56	class ObjectTypeDef:
57	    name: str
58	    fields: List[FieldDef]
59	    directives: List[Directive]
60	    interfaces: List[str]
61	    is_extend: bool = False
62	
63	
64	@dataclass
65	class InputDef:
66	    name: str
67	    fields: List[InputValueDef]
68	
69	
70	@dataclass
71	class Operation:
72	    op_type: str  # "query" | "mutation" | "subscription"
73	    name: Optional[str]
74	    var_defs: List[Tuple[str, TypeRef, Any, bool]]  # (name, type, default, has_default)
75	    selection_set: list
76	
77	
78	@dataclass
79	class FieldNode:
80	    name: str
81	    alias: Optional[str]
82	    args: Dict[str, Any]
83	    selection_set: Optional[list]  # None when the field has no subselection
84	
85	
86	@dataclass
87	class FragmentSpread:
88	    name: str
89	
90	
91	@dataclass
92	class InlineFragment:
93	    type_condition: Optional[str]
94	    selection_set: list
95	
96	
97	@dataclass
98	class FragmentDef:
99	    name: str
100	    type_condition: str
101	    selection_set: list
102	
103	
104	@dataclass
105	class Token:
106	    kind: str  # "name" | "int" | "float" | "string" | "punct" | "eof"
107	    value: str
108	    line: int
109	    col: int
110	
111	
112	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
113	# Lexer
114	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
115	
116	
117	def tokenize(text: str, source: str) -> List[Token]:
118	    tokens: List[Token] = []
119	    i = 0
120	    line = 1
121	    col = 1
122	    n = len(text)
123	
124	    def error(message: str, ln: Optional[int] = None, cl: Optional[int] = None):
125	        raise PlanError("ParseError", f"{source}:{ln or line}:{cl or col}: {message}")
126	
127	    while i < n:
128	        ch = text[i]
129	        if ch in " \t\r\n,":
130	            if ch == "\n":
131	                line += 1
132	                col = 1
133	            else:
134	                col += 1
135	            i += 1
136	            continue
137	        if ch == "#":
138	            while i < n and text[i] != "\n":
139	                i += 1
140	                col += 1
141	            continue
142	        start_line, start_col = line, col
143	        if ch == ".":
144	            if text[i : i + 3] == "...":
145	                tokens.append(Token("punct", "...", start_line, start_col))
146	                i += 3
147	                col += 3
148	                continue
149	            error("unexpected character '.'")
150	        if ch in PUNCTUATORS:
151	            tokens.append(Token("punct", ch, start_line, start_col))
152	            i += 1
153	            col += 1
154	            continue
155	        if ch == '"':
156	            if text[i : i + 3] == '"""':
157	                j = i + 3
158	                buf: List[str] = []
159	                closed = False
160	                while j < n:
161	                    if text[j] == "\\" and text[j + 1 : j + 4] == '"""':
162	                        buf.append('"""')
163	                        j += 4
164	                    elif text[j : j + 3] == '"""':
165	                        closed = True
166	                        break
167	                    else:
168	                        buf.append(text[j])
169	                        j += 1
170	                if not closed:
171	                    error("unterminated block string", start_line, start_col)
172	                segment = text[i : j + 3]
173	                tokens.append(Token("string", "".join(buf), start_line, start_col))
174	                i = j + 3
175	            else:
176	                j = i + 1
177	                buf = []
178	                closed = False
179	                while j < n:
180	                    c = text[j]
181	                    if c == '"':
182	                        closed = True
183	                        break
184	                    if c == "\n":
185	                        error("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
186	                    if c == "\\":
187	                        esc = text[j + 1] if j + 1 < n else ""
188	                        simple = {
189	                            '"': '"',
190	                            "\\": "\\",
191	                            "/": "/",
192	                            "b": "\b",
193	                            "f": "\f",
194	                            "n": "\n",
195	                            "r": "\r",
196	                            "t": "\t",
197	                        }
198	                        if esc == "u":
199	                            hexs = text[j + 2 : j + 6]
200	                            if len(hexs) < 4 or any(
201	                                c2 not in "0123456789abcdefABCDEF" for c2 in hexs
202	                            ):
203	                                error("invalid unicode escape", start_line, start_col)
204	                            buf.append(chr(int(hexs, 16)))
205	                            j += 6
206	                        elif esc in simple:
207	                            buf.append(simple[esc])
208	                            j += 2
209	                        else:
210	                            error(f"invalid escape '\\{esc}'", start_line, start_col)
211	                    else:
212	                        buf.append(c)
213	                        j += 1
214	                if not closed:
215	                    error("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
216	                segment = text[i : j + 1]
217	                tokens.append(Token("string", "".join(buf), start_line, start_col))
218	                i = j + 1
219	            newlines = segment.count("\n")
220	            if newlines:
221	                line += newlines
222	                col = len(segment) - segment.rindex("\n")
223	            else:
224	                col += len(segment)
225	            continue
226	        if ch == "-" or ch.isdigit():
227	            m = NUMBER_RE.match(text, i)
228	            if not m:
229	                error("invalid number", start_line, start_col)
230	            sval = m.group(0)
231	            kind = "float" if ("." in sval or "e" in sval or "E" in sval) else "int"
232	            tokens.append(Token(kind, sval, start_line, start_col))
233	            i = m.end()
234	            col += len(sval)
235	            continue
236	        if ch.isalpha() or ch == "_":
237	            j = i
238	            while j < n and (text[j].isalnum() or text[j] == "_"):
239	                j += 1
240	            tokens.append(Token("name", text[i:j], start_line, start_col))
241	            col += j - i
242	            i = j
243	            continue
244	        error(f"unexpected character {ch!r}")
245	    tokens.append(Token("eof", "", line, col))
246	    return tokens
247	
248	
249	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
250	# Parser
251	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
252	
253	
254	class Parser:
255	    def __init__(self, text: str, source: str):
256	        self.source = source
257	        self.tokens = tokenize(text, source)
258	        self.pos = 0
259	
260	    def peek(self) -> Token:
261	        return self.tokens[self.pos]
262	
263	    def error(self, message: str) -> "PlanError":
264	        tok = self.peek()
265	        raise PlanError("ParseError", f"{self.source}:{tok.line}:{tok.col}: {message}")
266	
267	    def describe(self) -> str:
268	        tok = self.peek()
269	        if tok.kind == "eof":
270	            return "end of input"
271	        return repr(tok.value)
272	
273	    def advance(self) -> Token:
274	        tok = self.tokens[self.pos]
275	        if tok.kind != "eof":
276	            self.pos += 1
277	        return tok
278	
279	    def at_punct(self, p: str) -> bool:
280	        tok = self.peek()
281	        return tok.kind == "punct" and tok.value == p
282	
283	    def eat_punct(self, p: str) -> bool:
284	        if self.at_punct(p):
285	            self.advance()
286	            return True
287	        return False
288	
289	    def expect_punct(self, p: str) -> None:
290	        if not self.eat_punct(p):
291	            self.error(f"expected '{p}', found {self.describe()}")
292	
293	    def at_name(self, name: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
294	        tok = self.peek()
295	        return tok.kind == "name" and (name is None or tok.value == name)
296	
297	    def expect_name(self) -> str:
298	        tok = self.peek()
299	        if tok.kind != "name":
300	            self.error(f"expected a name, found {self.describe()}")
301	        self.advance()
302	        return tok.value
303	
304	    # -- types ---------------------------------------------------------------
305	
306	    def parse_type_ref(self) -> TypeRef:
307	        if self.eat_punct("["):
308	            inner = self.parse_type_ref()
309	            self.expect_punct("]")
310	            ref: TypeRef = ("list", inner)
311	        else:
312	            ref = ("named", self.expect_name())
313	        if self.eat_punct("!"):
314	            ref = ("non_null", ref)
315	        return ref
316	
317	    # -- values ----------------------------------------------------------------
318	
319	    def parse_value(self, const: bool = False) -> Any:
320	        tok = self.peek()
321	        if tok.kind == "punct" and tok.value == "$":
322	            if const:
323	                self.error("variables are not allowed in this position")
324	            self.advance()
325	            return Var(self.expect_name())
326	        if tok.kind == "int":
327	            self.advance()
328	            return int(tok.value)
329	        if tok.kind == "float":
330	            self.advance()
331	            return float(tok.value)
332	        if tok.kind == "string":
333	            self.advance()
334	            return tok.value
335	        if tok.kind == "name":
336	            self.advance()
337	            if tok.value == "true":
338	                return True
339	            if tok.value == "false":
340	                return False
341	            if tok.value == "null":
342	                return None
343	            return tok.value  # enum value
344	        if self.eat_punct("["):
345	            items = []
346	            while not self.eat_punct("]"):
347	                items.append(self.parse_value(const))
348	            return items
349	        if self.eat_punct("{"):
350	            obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
351	            while not self.eat_punct("}"):
352	                key = self.expect_name()
353	                if key in obj:
354	                    self.error(f"duplicate object field '{key}'")
355	                self.expect_punct(":")
356	                obj[key] = self.parse_value(const)
357	            return obj
358	        self.error(f"expected a value, found {self.describe()}")
359	
360	    def parse_directives(self, const: bool = False) -> List[Directive]:
361	        directives = []
362	        while self.eat_punct("@"):
363	            name = self.expect_name()
364	            args: Dict[str, Any] = {}
365	            if self.eat_punct("("):
366	                while not self.eat_punct(")"):
367	                    arg_name = self.expect_name()
368	                    if arg_name in args:
369	                        self.error(f"duplicate argument '{arg_name}' on '@{name}'")
370	                    self.expect_punct(":")
371	                    args[arg_name] = self.parse_value(const)
372	            directives.append(Directive(name, args))
373	        return directives
374	
375	    # -- executable documents ---------------------------------------------------
376	
377	    def parse_selection_set(self) -> list:
378	        self.expect_punct("{")
379	        selections = []
380	        while not self.at_punct("}"):
381	            if self.peek().kind == "eof":
382	                self.error("unterminated selection set")
383	            selections.append(self.parse_selection())
384	        self.expect_punct("}")
385	        return selections
386	
387	    def parse_selection(self):
388	        if self.eat_punct("..."):
389	            if self.at_name("on"):
390	                self.advance()
391	                condition = self.expect_name()
392	                self.parse_directives()
393	                return InlineFragment(condition, self.parse_selection_set())
394	            if self.at_punct("{") or self.at_punct("@"):
395	                self.parse_directives()
396	                return InlineFragment(None, self.parse_selection_set())
397	            name = self.expect_name()
398	            self.parse_directives()
399	            return FragmentSpread(name)
400	        first = self.expect_name()
401	        alias = None
402	        name = first
403	        if self.eat_punct(":"):
404	            alias = first
405	            name = self.expect_name()
406	        args: Dict[str, Any] = {}
407	        if self.eat_punct("("):
408	            while not self.eat_punct(")"):
409	                arg_name = self.expect_name()
410	                if arg_name in args:
411	                    self.error(f"duplicate argument '{arg_name}'")
412	                self.expect_punct(":")
413	                args[arg_name] = self.parse_value()
414	        self.parse_directives()
415	        selection_set = None
416	        if self.at_punct("{"):
417	            selection_set = self.parse_selection_set()
418	        return FieldNode(name, alias, args, selection_set)
419	
420	
421	def parse_executable(text: str, source: str):
422	    """Parse an executable document. Returns (operations, fragments)."""
423	    parser = Parser(text, source)
424	    operations: List[Operation] = []
425	    fragments: Dict[str, FragmentDef] = {}
426	    while parser.peek().kind != "eof":
427	        if parser.at_punct("{"):
428	            operations.append(Operation("query", None, [], parser.parse_selection_set()))
429	            continue
430	        if parser.at_name("query") or parser.at_name("mutation") or parser.at_name("subscription"):
431	            op_type = parser.advance().value
432	            name = None
433	            if parser.peek().kind == "name":
434	                name = parser.advance().value
435	            var_defs = []
436	            if parser.eat_punct("("):
437	                while not parser.eat_punct(")"):
438	                    parser.expect_punct("$")
439	                    var_name = parser.expect_name()
440	                    parser.expect_punct(":")
441	                    var_type = parser.parse_type_ref()
442	                    default = None
443	                    has_default = False
444	                    if parser.eat_punct("="):
445	                        default = parser.parse_value(const=True)
446	                        has_default = True
447	                    parser.parse_directives(const=True)
448	                    var_defs.append((var_name, var_type, default, has_default))
449	            parser.parse_directives()
450	            operations.append(Operation(op_type, name, var_defs, parser.parse_selection_set()))
451	            continue
452	        if parser.at_name("fragment"):
453	            parser.advance()
454	            frag_name = parser.expect_name()
455	            if frag_name == "on":
456	                parser.error("fragment name cannot be 'on'")
457	            if not parser.at_name("on"):
458	                parser.error("expected 'on' after fragment name")
459	            parser.advance()
460	            condition = parser.expect_name()
461	            parser.parse_directives()
462	            selection_set = parser.parse_selection_set()
463	            if frag_name in fragments:
464	                parser.error(f"duplicate fragment '{frag_name}'")
465	            fragments[frag_name] = FragmentDef(frag_name, condition, selection_set)
466	            continue
467	        parser.error(f"unexpected {parser.describe()}")
468	    return operations, fragments
469	
470	
471	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
472	# Schema (SDL) documents
473	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
474	
475	
476	class SdlDocument:
477	    def __init__(self):
478	        self.types: List[ObjectTypeDef] = []
479	        self.interfaces: List[ObjectTypeDef] = []
480	        self.inputs: List[InputDef] = []
481	        self.scalars: List[str] = []
482	        self.enums: List[str] = []
483	        self.unions: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
484	        self.roots: Dict[str, str] = {}
485	        self.schema_seen = False
486	
487	
488	def _parse_field_def(parser: Parser) -> FieldDef:
489	    name = parser.expect_name()
490	    args: List[InputValueDef] = []
491	    if parser.eat_punct("("):
492	        while not parser.eat_punct(")"):
493	            if parser.peek().kind == "string":
494	                parser.advance()  # argument description
495	            args.append(_parse_input_value_def(parser))
496	    parser.expect_punct(":")
497	    type_ref = parser.parse_type_ref()
498	    directives = parser.parse_directives(const=True)
499	    return FieldDef(name, args, type_ref, directives)
500	
501	
502	def _parse_input_value_def(parser: Parser) -> InputValueDef:
503	    name = parser.expect_name()
504	    parser.expect_punct(":")
505	    type_ref = parser.parse_type_ref()
506	    default = None
507	    has_default = False
508	    if parser.eat_punct("="):
509	        default = parser.parse_value(const=True)
510	        has_default = True
511	    parser.parse_directives(const=True)
512	    return InputValueDef(name, type_ref, default, has_default)
513	
514	
515	def _parse_object_type(parser: Parser, is_extend: bool) -> ObjectTypeDef:
516	    name = parser.expect_name()
517	    interfaces: List[str] = []
518	    if parser.at_name("implements"):
519	        parser.advance()
520	        parser.eat_punct("&")
521	        interfaces.append(parser.expect_name())
522	        while parser.eat_punct("&"):
523	            interfaces.append(parser.expect_name())
524	    directives = parser.parse_directives(const=True)
525	    fields: List[FieldDef] = []
526	    if parser.eat_punct("{"):
527	        while not parser.eat_punct("}"):
528	            if parser.peek().kind == "string":
529	                parser.advance()  # field description
530	            fields.append(_parse_field_def(parser))
531	    return ObjectTypeDef(name, fields, directives, interfaces, is_extend)
532	
533	
534	def _parse_schema_body(parser: Parser, doc: SdlDocument) -> None:
535	    parser.parse_directives(const=True)
536	    parser.expect_punct("{")
537	    while not parser.eat_punct("}"):
538	        op = parser.expect_name()
539	        if op not in ("query", "mutation", "subscription"):
540	            parser.error(f"unknown root operation '{op}'")
541	        parser.expect_punct(":")
542	        type_name = parser.expect_name()
543	        if op in doc.roots:
544	            parser.error(f"duplicate root operation '{op}'")
545	        doc.roots[op] = type_name
546	
547	
548	def parse_schema_document(text: str, source: str) -> SdlDocument:
549	    parser = Parser(text, source)
550	    doc = SdlDocument()
551	    while parser.peek().kind != "eof":
552	        if parser.peek().kind == "string":
553	            parser.advance()  # definition description
554	        if parser.at_name("schema"):
555	            if doc.schema_seen:
556	                parser.error("duplicate schema definition")
557	            doc.schema_seen = True
558	            parser.advance()
559	            _parse_schema_body(parser, doc)
560	        elif parser.at_name("scalar"):
561	            parser.advance()
562	            doc.scalars.append(parser.expect_name())
563	            parser.parse_directives(const=True)
564	        elif parser.at_name("type"):
565	            parser.advance()
566	            doc.types.append(_parse_object_type(parser, is_extend=False))
567	        elif parser.at_name("interface"):
568	            parser.advance()
569	            doc.interfaces.append(_parse_object_type(parser, is_extend=False))
570	        elif parser.at_name("input"):
571	            parser.advance()
572	            name = parser.expect_name()
573	            parser.parse_directives(const=True)
574	            fields: List[InputValueDef] = []
575	            if parser.eat_punct("{"):
576	                while not parser.eat_punct("}"):
577	                    if parser.peek().kind == "string":
578	                        parser.advance()
579	                    fields.append(_parse_input_value_def(parser))
580	            doc.inputs.append(InputDef(name, fields))
581	        elif parser.at_name("enum"):
582	            parser.advance()
583	            doc.enums.append(parser.expect_name())
584	            parser.parse_directives(const=True)
585	            if parser.eat_punct("{"):
586	                while not parser.eat_punct("}"):
587	                    if parser.peek().kind == "string":
588	                        parser.advance()
589	                    parser.expect_name()
590	                    parser.parse_directives(const=True)
591	        elif parser.at_name("union"):
592	            parser.advance()
593	            union_name = parser.expect_name()
594	            parser.parse_directives(const=True)
595	            members: List[str] = []
596	            if parser.eat_punct("="):
597	                parser.eat_punct("|")
598	                members.append(parser.expect_name())
599	                while parser.eat_punct("|"):
600	                    members.append(parser.expect_name())
601	            doc.unions[union_name] = members
602	        elif parser.at_name("directive"):
603	            parser.advance()
604	            parser.expect_punct("@")
605	            parser.expect_name()
606	            if parser.eat_punct("("):
607	                while not parser.eat_punct(")"):
608	                    _parse_input_value_def(parser)
609	            if parser.at_name("repeatable"):
610	                parser.advance()
611	            if not parser.at_name("on"):
612	                parser.error("expected 'on' in directive definition")
613	            parser.advance()
614	            parser.eat_punct("|")
615	            parser.expect_name()
616	            while parser.eat_punct("|"):
617	                parser.expect_name()
618	        elif parser.at_name("extend"):
619	            parser.advance()
620	            if parser.at_name("type"):
621	                parser.advance()
622	                doc.types.append(_parse_object_type(parser, is_extend=True))
623	            elif parser.at_name("schema"):
624	                parser.advance()
625	                _parse_schema_body(parser, doc)
626	            else:
627	                parser.error("unsupported 'extend' target")
628	        else:
629	            parser.error(f"unexpected {parser.describe()}")
630	    return doc

1	"""Direct GraphQL query execution over entity change events.
2	
3	Compiles a query operation into per-root filters and selection trees (sharing
4	the planner's fragment, variable and @link semantics), folds an NDJSON entity
5	change stream into the current primary-key snapshot of every reachable
6	entity, then answers the query once against those snapshots.
7	
8	List roots return every matching row in first-insert order (UPDATE replaces a
9	row in place; DELETE followed by re-INSERT moves it to the end); single-object
10	roots return null on no match and fail with QueryError on more than one match.
11	Single-object @link fields follow local -> target primary key; list @link
12	fields equality-match arbitrary scalar target fields in target insert order.
13	"""
14	
15	from __future__ import annotations
16	
17	import json
18	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
19	
20	from .errors import PlanError
21	from .gql import Var, parse_executable
22	from .planner import Planner
23	from .schema import Entity, Schema, TypeInfo, named_of
24	from .subscription import EVENT_OPS, _OrderedStore, _is_list_type
25	
26	_MISSING = object()
27	
28	
29	class ExecNode:
30	    """A compiled field in the query selection tree.
31	
32	    Leaf fields carry ``field_type`` and no children. Link fields also carry
33	    the validated @link mapping (local/target field names, target entity) and
34	    their compiled children; ``is_list`` selects list resolution.
35	    """
36	
37	    __slots__ = (
38	        "response_key",
39	        "field_name",
40	        "field_type",
41	        "required",
42	        "is_list",
43	        "local",
44	        "local_types",
45	        "target",
46	        "target_types",
47	        "target_table",
48	        "children",
49	    )
50	
51	    def __init__(
52	        self,
53	        response_key: str,
54	        field_name: str,
55	        field_type=None,
56	        required: bool = False,
57	        is_list: bool = False,
58	        local: Optional[List[str]] = None,
59	        local_types: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
60	        target: Optional[List[str]] = None,
61	        target_types: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
62	        target_table: Optional[str] = None,
63	        children: Optional[List["ExecNode"]] = None,
64	    ):
65	        self.response_key = response_key
66	        self.field_name = field_name
67	        self.field_type = field_type
68	        self.required = required
69	        self.is_list = is_list
70	        self.local = local
71	        self.local_types = local_types
72	        self.target = target
73	        self.target_types = target_types
74	        self.target_table = target_table
75	        self.children = children
76	
77	
78	class ExecContext:
79	    """Everything execution needs beyond the compiled roots."""
80	
81	    __slots__ = ("schema", "entity_keys", "key_types", "snapshots")
82	
83	    def __init__(self, schema: Schema, entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
84	                 key_types: Dict[str, List[Any]]):
85	        self.schema = schema
86	        self.entity_keys = entity_keys
87	        # table -> primary key field type refs, in declared order
88	        self.key_types = key_types
89	        self.snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore] = {}
90	
91	
92	class QueryCompiler(Planner):
93	    """Compiles a query document into one executable entry per root field."""
94	
95	    def __init__(self, schema: Schema, variables: Dict[str, Any],
96	                 bound_args_allowed: bool = False):
97	        super().__init__(schema, variables, bound_args_allowed)
98	        self.entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
99	        self.key_types: Dict[str, List[Any]] = {}
100	
101	    def compile(
102	        self, query_text: str, source: str, operation_name: Optional[str]
103	    ) -> Tuple[Optional[str], List[dict]]:
104	        operations, self.fragments = parse_executable(query_text, source)
105	        op = self._select_operation(operations, operation_name)
106	        if op.op_type != "query":
107	            raise PlanError(
108	                "UnsupportedOperation",
109	                f"{op.op_type} operations are not supported by query-exec",
110	            )
111	        self.var_map = {}
112	        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
113	            if name in self.var_map:
114	                raise PlanError(
115	                    "VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once"
116	                )
117	            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)
118	
119	        root_type_name = self.schema.roots.get("query")
120	        root_type = self.schema.types.get(root_type_name) if root_type_name else None
121	        if root_type is None:
122	            raise PlanError(
123	                "MappingError",
124	                "schema does not define a root type for query operations",
125	            )
126	
127	        selections = self._expand(op.selection_set, root_type.name, [])
128	        if not selections:
129	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "query has an empty selection set")
130	
131	        roots: List[dict] = []
132	        self.entity_keys = {}
133	        self.key_types = {}
134	        for node in selections:
135	            # Introspection root fields cost 0 and are only recognized while
136	            # complexity control is enabled; the engine models no introspection
137	            # data, so such a root resolves deterministically to null.
138	            if self.bound_args_allowed and node.name in ("__schema", "__type"):
139	                roots.append({"introspection": node.alias or node.name})
140	                continue
141	            roots.append(self._compile_root(node, root_type))
142	        return op.name, roots
143	
144	    # -- operation selection ---------------------------------------------------
145	
146	    @staticmethod
147	    def _select_operation(operations, operation_name):
148	        if operation_name is not None:
149	            for op in operations:
150	                if op.name == operation_name:
151	                    return op
152	            raise PlanError("InvalidOperation", f"no operation named '{operation_name}'")
153	        if not operations:
154	            raise PlanError("InvalidRequest", "document contains no operations")
155	        if len(operations) == 1:
156	            return operations[0]
157	        raise PlanError(
158	            "InvalidRequest",
159	            "multiple operations found; select one with --operation",
160	        )
161	
162	    # -- roots ------------------------------------------------------------------
163	
164	    def _compile_root(self, node, root_type: TypeInfo) -> dict:
165	        key = node.alias or node.name
166	        field = root_type.fields.get(node.name)
167	        if field is None:
168	            raise PlanError(
169	                "UnknownField",
170	                f"unknown root field '{node.name}' on type '{root_type.name}'",
171	            )
172	        type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
173	        target = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
174	        entity = target.entity if target is not None else None
175	        if entity is None:
176	            raise PlanError(
177	                "UnknownEntity",
178	                f"root field '{node.name}' does not return a mapped entity type",
179	            )
180	        if node.selection_set is None:
181	            raise PlanError(
182	                "InvalidQuery", f"root field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
183	            )
184	        for arg_name, arg_def in field.args.items():
185	            if (
186	                arg_def.type[0] == "non_null"
187	                and not arg_def.has_default
188	                and arg_name not in node.args
189	            ):
190	                raise PlanError(
191	                    "UnknownField",
192	                    f"missing required argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
193	                )
194	        is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
195	        filter_obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
196	        filter_types: Dict[str, Any] = {}
197	        for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
198	            if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):
199	                # A list-size bound used for complexity; never a filter. If it
200	                # is a variable, resolve it so type/required-variable errors
201	                # are reported by the normal validation phase.
202	                if isinstance(value, Var):
203	                    self._resolve(value)
204	                continue
205	            if arg_name not in field.args:
206	                raise PlanError(
207	                    "UnknownField",
208	                    f"unknown argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
209	                )
210	            target_field = target.fields.get(arg_name)
211	            if target_field is None or not self.schema.is_leaf(
212	                named_of(target_field.type_ref)
213	            ):
214	                raise PlanError(
215	                    "UnknownField",
216	                    f"argument '{arg_name}' does not match a filterable field of "
217	                    f"entity '{entity.table}'",
218	                )
219	            filter_obj[arg_name] = self._resolve(value)
220	            filter_types[arg_name] = target_field.type_ref
221	
222	        self.entity_keys[entity.table] = list(entity.key)
223	        self.key_types[entity.table] = [
224	            target.fields[name].type_ref for name in entity.key
225	        ]
226	        children = self._compile_fields(
227	            target, entity, node.selection_set, key
228	        )
229	        return {
230	            "response_key": key,
231	            "field_name": node.name,
232	            "table": entity.table,
233	            "filter": filter_obj,
234	            "filter_types": filter_types,
235	            "is_list": is_list,
236	            "children": children,
237	        }
238	
239	    # -- selection tree -----------------------------------------------------------
240	
241	    def _compile_fields(
242	        self,
243	        info: TypeInfo,
244	        entity: Entity,
245	        selection_set,
246	        path: str,
247	    ) -> List[ExecNode]:
248	        selections = self._expand(selection_set, info.name, [])
249	        if not selections:
250	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", f"empty selection set at '{path}'")
251	        children: List[ExecNode] = []
252	        seen = set()
253	        for node in selections:
254	            key = node.alias or node.name
255	            node_path = f"{path}.{key}"
256	            field = info.fields.get(node.name)
257	            if field is None:
258	                raise PlanError(
259	                    "UnknownField", f"unknown field '{node.name}' on type '{info.name}'"
260	                )
261	            type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
262	            if self.schema.is_leaf(type_name):
263	                if node.selection_set is not None:
264	                    raise PlanError(
265	                        "InvalidQuery",
266	                        f"scalar field '{node.name}' must not have a selection set",
267	                    )
268	                if node.args:
269	                    raise PlanError(
270	                        "InvalidQuery",
271	                        f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
272	                    )
273	                if key not in seen:
274	                    seen.add(key)
275	                    children.append(ExecNode(key, node.name, field.type_ref))
276	                continue
277	            is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
278	            for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
279	                if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):
280	                    if isinstance(value, Var):
281	                        self._resolve(value)
282	                    continue
283	                raise PlanError(
284	                    "InvalidQuery",
285	                    f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
286	                )
287	            if node.selection_set is None:
288	                raise PlanError(
289	                    "InvalidQuery", f"field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
290	                )
291	            required = field.type_ref[0] == "non_null"
292	            if field.link is None:
293	                raise PlanError(
294	                    "MappingError",
295	                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' is missing an @link directive",
296	                )
297	            target_info = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
298	            if target_info is None:
299	                raise PlanError(
300	                    "MappingError",
301	                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' has unsupported type '{type_name}'",
302	                )
303	            target_entity = target_info.entity
304	            if target_entity is None:
305	                raise PlanError(
306	                    "UnknownEntity",
307	                    f"type '{target_info.name}' is not mapped to an entity",
308	                )
309	            local, target_fields, _as_array = field.link
310	            if is_list:
311	                for name in local:
312	                    if not _is_scalar_value_field(self.schema, info.fields.get(name)):
313	                        raise PlanError(
314	                            "MappingError",
315	                            f"@link local field '{name}' of type '{info.name}' "
316	                            f"must be a scalar",
317	                        )
318	                for name in target_fields:
319	                    matched = target_info.fields.get(name)
320	                    if matched is None:
321	                        raise PlanError(
322	                            "MappingError",
323	                            f"@link target field '{name}' is not a field of type "
324	                            f"'{target_info.name}'",
325	                        )
326	                    if not _is_scalar_value_field(self.schema, matched):
327	                        raise PlanError(
328	                            "MappingError",
329	                            f"@link target field '{name}' of type "
330	                            f"'{target_info.name}' must be a scalar",
331	                        )
332	            elif target_fields != target_entity.key:
333	                raise PlanError(
334	                    "InvalidJoin",
335	                    f"@link target {target_fields} does not match the primary key of "
336	                    f"entity '{target_entity.table}'",
337	                )
338	            nested = self._compile_fields(
339	                target_info, target_entity, node.selection_set, node_path
340	            )
341	            if key not in seen:
342	                seen.add(key)
343	                self.entity_keys[target_entity.table] = list(target_entity.key)
344	                self.key_types[target_entity.table] = [
345	                    target_info.fields[name].type_ref for name in target_entity.key
346	                ]
347	                children.append(
348	                    ExecNode(
349	                        key,
350	                        node.name,
351	                        field.type_ref,
352	                        required=required,
353	                        is_list=is_list,
354	                        local=list(local),
355	                        local_types=[info.fields[n].type_ref for n in local],
356	                        target=list(target_fields),
357	                        target_types=[
358	                            target_info.fields[n].type_ref for n in target_fields
359	                        ],
360	                        target_table=target_entity.table,
361	                        children=nested,
362	                    )
363	                )
364	        return children
365	
366	
367	def _is_scalar_value_field(schema: Schema, field) -> bool:
368	    """Whether a field holds a single (non-list) scalar value."""
369	    if field is None:
370	        return False
371	    return (
372	        not _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
373	        and named_of(field.type_ref) in schema.scalars
374	    )
375	
376	
377	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
378	# Event folding
379	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
380	
381	
382	def fold_events(ctx: ExecContext, events_text: str, source: str) -> None:
383	    """Parse and validate every event line, then fold them into snapshots."""
384	    events: List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]] = []
385	    for lineno, raw in enumerate(events_text.splitlines(), 1):
386	        line = raw.strip()
387	        if not line:
388	            continue
389	        events.append((lineno, _parse_event(line, source, lineno)))
390	
391	    for lineno, event in events:
392	        _apply_event(ctx, event, source, lineno)
393	
394	
395	def _parse_event(line: str, source: str, lineno: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
396	    try:
397	        event = json.loads(line)
398	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
399	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: invalid JSON: {exc.msg}")
400	    if not isinstance(event, dict):
401	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event must be a JSON object")
402	    for key in ("op", "entity", "before", "after"):
403	        if key not in event:
404	            raise PlanError(
405	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event is missing '{key}'"
406	            )
407	    if event["op"] not in EVENT_OPS:
408	        raise PlanError(
409	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: unknown op {event['op']!r}"
410	        )
411	    if not isinstance(event["entity"], str) or not event["entity"]:
412	        raise PlanError(
413	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: 'entity' must be a non-empty string"
414	        )
415	    for key in ("before", "after"):
416	        if event[key] is not None and not isinstance(event[key], dict):
417	            raise PlanError(
418	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: '{key}' must be an object or null"
419	            )
420	    return event
421	
422	
423	def _apply_event(
424	    ctx: ExecContext, event: Dict[str, Any], source: str, lineno: int
425	) -> None:
426	    """Maintain the current snapshot store for one validated event.
427	
428	    Events for entities the query cannot reach are ignored (as in
429	    subscription-push); for every reachable entity the operative snapshot
430	    must carry a well-formed scalar primary key.
431	    """
432	    key_fields = ctx.entity_keys.get(event["entity"])
433	    if key_fields is None:
434	        return
435	    op = event["op"]
436	    if op in ("INSERT", "UPDATE"):
437	        snapshot = event["after"]
438	        if snapshot is None:
439	            raise PlanError(
440	                "EventError",
441	                f"{source}:{lineno}: {op} event requires an 'after' snapshot",
442	            )
443	        key = _require_key(
444	            key_fields, ctx.key_types[event["entity"]], snapshot,
445	            event["entity"], ctx.schema, source, lineno,
446	        )
447	        ctx.snapshots.setdefault(event["entity"], _OrderedStore()).upsert(key, snapshot)
448	        return
449	    snapshot = event["before"]
450	    if snapshot is None:
451	        raise PlanError(
452	            "EventError",
453	            f"{source}:{lineno}: DELETE event requires a 'before' snapshot",
454	        )
455	    key = _require_key(
456	        key_fields, ctx.key_types[event["entity"]], snapshot,
457	        event["entity"], ctx.schema, source, lineno,
458	    )
459	    ctx.snapshots.setdefault(event["entity"], _OrderedStore()).delete(key)
460	
461	
462	def _require_key(
463	    key_fields: List[str],
464	    key_types: List[Any],
465	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
466	    table: str,
467	    schema: Schema,
468	    source: str,
469	    lineno: int,
470	) -> Tuple[Any, ...]:
471	    """Build a primary-key tuple, rejecting any malformed or incomplete one."""
472	    values: List[Any] = []
473	    for name, type_ref in zip(key_fields, key_types):
474	        if name not in snapshot:
475	            raise PlanError(
476	                "EventError",
477	                f"{source}:{lineno}: snapshot of entity '{table}' is missing "
478	                f"primary key field '{name}'",
479	            )
480	        value = snapshot[name]
481	        if value is None or isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
482	            raise PlanError(
483	                "EventError",
484	                f"{source}:{lineno}: primary key field '{name}' of entity '{table}' "
485	                f"cannot be null or a composite value",
486	            )
487	        _check_value_shape(schema, type_ref, value, f"{table}.{name}")
488	        values.append(value)
489	    return tuple(values)
490	
491	
492	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
493	# Query execution
494	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
495	
496	
497	def execute(roots: List[dict], ctx: ExecContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
498	    """Answer the compiled query against the current snapshot stores."""
499	    data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
500	    for root in roots:
501	        if "introspection" in root:
502	            # No introspection data is modeled; a cost-0 introspection root is
503	            # answered deterministically with null.
504	            data[root["introspection"]] = None
505	            continue
506	        data[root["response_key"]] = _execute_root(root, ctx)
507	    return {"data": data}
508	
509	
510	def _execute_root(root: dict, ctx: ExecContext) -> Any:
511	    store = ctx.snapshots.get(root["table"])
512	    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
513	    if store is not None:
514	        for row in store.values():
515	            if _matches_filter(root, row, ctx):
516	                rows.append(row)
517	    path = root["response_key"]
518	    if root["is_list"]:
519	        return [_project(root["children"], row, ctx, path) for row in rows]
520	    if not rows:
521	        return None
522	    if len(rows) > 1:
523	        raise PlanError(
524	            "QueryError",
525	            f"single-object root field '{path}' matched {len(rows)} entities",
526	        )
527	    return _project(root["children"], rows[0], ctx, path)
528	
529	
530	def _matches_filter(root: dict, snapshot: Dict[str, Any], ctx: ExecContext) -> bool:
531	    for name, expected in root["filter"].items():
532	        if name not in snapshot:
533	            raise PlanError(
534	                "EventError",
535	                f"snapshot of entity '{root['table']}' is missing filter field "
536	                f"'{name}'",
537	            )
538	        value = snapshot[name]
539	        _check_value_shape(
540	            ctx.schema,
541	            root["filter_types"][name],
542	            value,
543	            f"{root['response_key']}({name})",
544	        )
545	        if value != expected:
546	            return False
547	    return True
548	
549	
550	def _project(
551	    nodes: List[ExecNode],
552	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
553	    ctx: ExecContext,
554	    path: str,
555	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
556	    """Project compiled selections over one entity snapshot."""
557	    data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
558	    for node in nodes:
559	        node_path = f"{path}.{node.response_key}"
560	        if node.children is None:
561	            if node.field_name not in snapshot:
562	                raise PlanError(
563	                    "EventError",
564	                    f"snapshot is missing field '{node.field_name}' for '{node_path}'",
565	                )
566	            value = snapshot[node.field_name]
567	            _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, node.field_type, value, node_path)
568	            data[node.response_key] = value
569	            continue
570	        if node.is_list:
571	            data[node.response_key] = _project_list(node, snapshot, ctx, node_path)
572	            continue
573	        related = _resolve_object(node, snapshot, ctx, node_path)
574	        if related is None:
575	            if node.required:
576	                raise PlanError(
577	                    "EventError",
578	                    f"non-null relationship '{node_path}' resolved to null",
579	                )
580	            data[node.response_key] = None
581	        else:
582	            data[node.response_key] = _project(
583	                node.children, related, ctx, node_path
584	            )
585	    return data
586	
587	
588	def _project_list(
589	    node: ExecNode,
590	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
591	    ctx: ExecContext,
592	    path: str,
593	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
594	    matches = _resolve_list(node, snapshot, ctx, path)
595	    return [_project(node.children, related, ctx, path) for related in matches]
596	
597	
598	# -- @link resolution -----------------------------------------------------------
599	
600	
601	def _read_local(
602	    node: ExecNode, snapshot: Dict[str, Any], ctx: ExecContext, path: str
603	) -> Optional[List[Any]]:
604	    """Read @link local values; None means any local value is null."""
605	    local_values: List[Any] = []
606	    for name, type_ref in zip(node.local, node.local_types):
607	        if name not in snapshot:
608	            raise PlanError(
609	                "EventError",
610	                f"snapshot is missing local key field '{name}' for '{path}'",
611	            )
612	        value = snapshot[name]
613	        if value is None:
614	            return None
615	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
616	            raise PlanError(
617	                "EventError",
618	                f"local key field '{name}' for '{path}' cannot form a scalar key",
619	            )
620	        _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, type_ref, value, path)
621	        local_values.append(value)
622	    return local_values
623	
624	
625	def _check_target_fields(
626	    node: ExecNode, related: Dict[str, Any], ctx: ExecContext, path: str
627	) -> None:
628	    """Ensure every matched target field is present with a compatible scalar."""
629	    for name, type_ref in zip(node.target, node.target_types):
630	        if name not in related:
631	            raise PlanError(
632	                "EventError",
633	                f"target snapshot of entity '{node.target_table}' is missing key "
634	                f"field '{name}' for '{path}'",
635	            )
636	        value = related[name]
637	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
638	            raise PlanError(
639	                "EventError",
640	                f"target key field '{name}' for '{path}' cannot be matched as a "
641	                f"scalar",
642	            )
643	        if value is not None:
644	            _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, type_ref, value, path)
645	
646	
647	def _check_primary_key(node: ExecNode, ctx: ExecContext, related: Dict[str, Any],
648	                       path: str) -> None:
649	    """Ensure a matched target snapshot supplies a well-formed primary key."""
650	    key_fields = ctx.entity_keys[node.target_table]
651	    key_types = ctx.key_types[node.target_table]
652	    for name, type_ref in zip(key_fields, key_types):
653	        if name not in related:
654	            raise PlanError(
655	                "EventError",
656	                f"target snapshot of entity '{node.target_table}' for '{path}' is "
657	                f"missing primary key field '{name}'",
658	            )
659	        value = related[name]
660	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)) or value is None:
661	            raise PlanError(
662	                "EventError",
663	                f"primary key field '{name}' of entity '{node.target_table}' for "
664	                f"'{path}' cannot be a key",
665	            )
666	        _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, type_ref, value, path)
667	
668	
669	def _resolve_object(
670	    node: ExecNode,
671	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
672	    ctx: ExecContext,
673	    path: str,
674	) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
675	    """Follow a single-object @link to the unique current target snapshot."""
676	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, ctx, path)
677	    if local_values is None:
678	        return None
679	
680	    target_store = ctx.snapshots.get(node.target_table)
681	    related = (
682	        _MISSING
683	        if target_store is None
684	        else target_store.rows.get(tuple(local_values), _MISSING)
685	    )
686	    if related is _MISSING:
687	        rendered = ", ".join(
688	            f"{name}: {json.dumps(value)}"
689	            for name, value in zip(node.target, local_values)
690	        )
691	        raise PlanError(
692	            "EventError",
693	            f"no current snapshot of entity '{node.target_table}' for '{path}' "
694	            f"with key {{{rendered}}}",
695	        )
696	    _check_target_fields(node, related, ctx, path)
697	    return related
698	
699	
700	def _resolve_list(
701	    node: ExecNode,
702	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
703	    ctx: ExecContext,
704	    path: str,
705	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
706	    """Match all current target snapshots for a list @link, in insert order.
707	
708	    An empty list stands for both an absent relationship (any local value
709	    null) and one without a current match.
710	    """
711	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, ctx, path)
712	    if local_values is None:
713	        return []
714	
715	    target_store = ctx.snapshots.get(node.target_table)
716	    if target_store is None:
717	        return []
718	    expected = tuple(local_values)
719	    matches: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
720	    for related in target_store.values():
721	        _check_target_fields(node, related, ctx, path)
722	        values = tuple(related[name] for name in node.target)
723	        if values != expected or None in values:
724	            continue
725	        _check_primary_key(node, ctx, related, path)
726	        matches.append(related)
727	    return matches
728	
729	
730	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
731	# Scalar / enum / list shape validation against the schema
732	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
733	
734	
735	def _check_value_shape(
736	    schema: Schema, type_ref, value: Any, path: str
737	) -> None:
738	    """Validate a snapshot value against a field's declared shape.
739	
740	    A null value is accepted for nullable positions and rejected for
741	    non-null ones; lists must be JSON arrays (elements checked recursively,
742	    honoring their own non-null wrappers) and leaf values must belong to the
743	    declared scalar/enum primitive family.
744	    """
745	    non_null = type_ref[0] == "non_null"
746	    if non_null:
747	        type_ref = type_ref[1]
748	    if value is None:
749	        if non_null:
750	            raise PlanError(
751	                "EventError", f"non-null field '{path}' resolved to null"
752	            )
753	        return
754	    if type_ref[0] == "list":
755	        if not isinstance(value, list):
756	            raise PlanError(
757	                "EventError",
758	                f"field '{path}' expects a list but the snapshot value is not an array",
759	            )
760	        for item in value:
761	            _check_value_shape(schema, type_ref[1], item, path)
762	        return
763	    name = type_ref[1]
764	    if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
765	        raise PlanError(
766	            "EventError", f"field '{path}' cannot hold a composite value"
767	        )
768	    if name == "Int":
769	        if not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool):
770	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects an Int value")
771	    elif name == "Float":
772	        if not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or isinstance(value, bool):
773	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects a Float value")
774	    elif name == "String":
775	        if not isinstance(value, str):
776	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects a String value")
777	    elif name == "ID":
778	        if not (
779	            isinstance(value, str)
780	            or (isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool))
781	        ):
782	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects an ID value")
783	    elif name == "Boolean":
784	        if not isinstance(value, bool):
785	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects a Boolean value")
786	    elif name in schema.enums:
787	        if not isinstance(value, str):
788	            raise PlanError(
789	                "EventError", f"enum field '{path}' expects a string enum value"
790	            )
791	    # Other custom scalar names accept any scalar JSON value.

1	"""Query complexity control.
2	
3	Computes a deterministic request-complexity score from the same GraphQL
4	document and variables used by execution, strictly *before* any resolver,
5	indexed-entity read or subscription is established. Over-limit requests stop
6	with a single ``QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED`` GraphQL error without touching the
7	entity snapshots.
8	
9	Scoring rules
10	-------------
11	* the selected operation is walked from its root selection set;
12	* every leaf field costs 1; a composite field costs only the sum of its
13	  children (the object container itself is free);
14	* repeated fields and distinct aliases are scored independently;
15	* fragments are inlined once at each spread position; an inline fragment
16	  contributes its selection directly;
17	* introspection fields ``__schema`` and ``__type`` cost 0;
18	* list fields scale their sub-selection by an effective item upper bound read
19	  from a ``first`` or ``limit`` argument -- a literal positive integer first,
20	  then a positive-integer variable of the same name -- falling back to
21	  ``DEFAULT_LIST_BOUND`` when the argument is absent, non-positive or
22	  non-integer. Variable values keep their GraphQL type validation from the
23	  existing validation phase; the scorer never rejects one (a non-integer bound
24	  simply means "no usable bound").
25	
26	The scorer walks the raw AST rather than the planner's merged selection so the
27	"repeated fields count separately" requirement holds regardless of the
28	response-key de-duplication execution performs.
29	"""
30	
31	from __future__ import annotations
32	
33	import os
34	from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional
35	
36	from .errors import PlanError
37	from .gql import (
38	    FieldNode,
39	    FragmentSpread,
40	    InlineFragment,
41	    Var,
42	    parse_executable,
43	)
44	from .planner import Planner, _is_list_type
45	from .schema import Schema, TypeInfo, named_of

47	DEFAULT_LIST_BOUND = 1000
48	LIMIT_ENV_VAR = "GRAPHQL_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT"
49	
50	# Argument names that may supply a list item upper bound, in priority order.
51	BOUND_ARG_NAMES = ("first", "limit")
