54	class QueryComplexityExceeded(PlanError):
55	    """The selected operation scores strictly above the configured limit.
56	
57	    Rendered as a GraphQL response on stdout (``data: null`` plus a single
58	    error whose ``extensions.code`` is QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED) rather than
59	    the usual ``{code, message}`` stderr envelope.
60	    """
61	
62	    def __init__(self, complexity: int, limit: int):
63	        super().__init__(
64	            "QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED",
65	            f"query complexity {complexity} exceeds the configured limit {limit}",
66	        )
67	        self.complexity = complexity
68	        self.limit = limit
69	
70	
71	def complexity_error_payload(complexity: int, limit: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
72	    """Build the GraphQL-style response emitted for an over-limit request."""
73	    return {
74	        "data": None,
75	        "errors": [
76	            {
77	                "message": (
78	                    f"query complexity {complexity} exceeds the configured "
79	                    f"limit {limit}"
80	                ),
81	                "extensions": {"code": "QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED"},
82	            }
83	        ],
84	    }

87	def load_complexity_limit(raw: Optional[str]) -> Optional[int]:
88	    """Validate a GRAPHQL_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT value.
89	
90	    Returns ``None`` when the control is disabled (the variable is unset or
91	    ``"0"``), otherwise the positive integer limit. A negative, non-integer or
92	    otherwise unparseable value raises INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT.
93	    """
94	    if raw is None:
95	        return None
96	    text = raw.strip()
97	    try:
98	        value = int(text)
99	    except ValueError:
100	        raise PlanError(
101	            "INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT",
102	            f"value {raw!r} must be a non-negative integer",
103	        )
104	    if value < 0:
105	        raise PlanError(
106	            "INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT",
107	            "query complexity limit must not be negative",
108	        )
109	    if value == 0:
110	        return None
111	    return value

114	def load_limit_from_env(
115	    environ: Optional[Dict[str, Optional[str]]] = None,
116	) -> Optional[int]:
117	    """Read and validate the limit from the process environment."""
118	    env = os.environ if environ is None else environ
119	    return load_complexity_limit(env.get(LIMIT_ENV_VAR))

122	class ComplexityCalculator(Planner):
123	    """Scores one selected operation using the planner's type knowledge.
124	
125	    Only fragment type-condition matching is inherited; the selection walk is
126	    intentionally separate so it never merges repeated fields.
127	    """
128	
129	    def score_operation(self, op, fragments: Dict[str, Any]) -> int:
130	        self.fragments = fragments
131	        self.var_map = {}
132	        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
133	            if name in self.var_map:
134	                raise PlanError(
135	                    "VariablesError",
136	                    f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once",
137	                )
138	            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)
139	
140	        root_name = self.schema.roots.get(op.op_type)
141	        root_info = self.schema.types.get(root_name) if root_name else None
142	        if root_info is None:
143	            raise PlanError(
144	                "UnknownField",
145	                f"schema does not define a root type for {op.op_type} operations",
146	            )
147	        return self._walk_set(op.selection_set, root_info, [])
148	
149	    # -- list bounds ----------------------------------------------------------
150	
151	    def _resolve_bound(self, value: Any) -> Optional[int]:
152	        """Resolve a first/limit argument to a positive integer, else None."""
153	        if isinstance(value, Var):
154	            spec = self.var_map.get(value.name)
155	            if spec is None:
156	                # An undeclared variable is reported by the regular validation
157	                # phase; complexity treats it as "no usable bound".
158	                return None
159	            _type_ref, default, has_default = spec
160	            if value.name in self.variables:
161	                value = self.variables[value.name]
162	            elif has_default:
163	                value = default
164	            else:
165	                return None
166	        if isinstance(value, bool):
167	            return None
168	        if isinstance(value, int) and value > 0:
169	            return value
170	        return None
171	
172	    def _bound_for(self, node: FieldNode) -> int:
173	        """Effective item upper bound for a list field."""
174	        for arg_name in BOUND_ARG_NAMES:
175	            if arg_name in node.args:
176	                bound = self._resolve_bound(node.args[arg_name])
177	                return bound if bound is not None else DEFAULT_LIST_BOUND
178	        return DEFAULT_LIST_BOUND
179	
180	    # -- selection walk -------------------------------------------------------
181	
182	    def _walk_set(self, selections, info: TypeInfo, stack: List[str]) -> int:
183	        return sum(self._walk_one(sel, info, stack) for sel in selections)
184	
185	    def _walk_one(self, sel, info: TypeInfo, stack: List[str]) -> int:
186	        if isinstance(sel, FieldNode):
187	            return self._walk_field(sel, info, stack)
188	        if isinstance(sel, FragmentSpread):
189	            frag = self.fragments.get(sel.name)
190	            if frag is None:
191	                raise PlanError(
192	                    "InvalidQuery", f"unknown fragment '{sel.name}'"
193	                )
194	            if sel.name in stack:
195	                raise PlanError(
196	                    "InvalidQuery", f"fragment cycle involving '{sel.name}'"
197	                )
198	            if not self._type_condition_matches(frag.type_condition, info.name):
199	                return 0
200	            frag_info = self.schema.types.get(frag.type_condition, info)
201	            return self._walk_set(
202	                frag.selection_set, frag_info, stack + [sel.name]
203	            )
204	        if isinstance(sel, InlineFragment):
205	            if sel.type_condition is None:
206	                return self._walk_set(sel.selection_set, info, stack)
207	            if not self._type_condition_matches(sel.type_condition, info.name):
208	                return 0
209	            inner_info = self.schema.types.get(sel.type_condition, info)
210	            return self._walk_set(sel.selection_set, inner_info, stack)
211	        return 0
212	
213	    def _walk_field(self, node: FieldNode, info: TypeInfo, stack: List[str]) -> int:
214	        if node.name in ("__schema", "__type"):
215	            return 0
216	        field = info.fields.get(node.name)
217	        if field is None:
218	            raise PlanError(
219	                "UnknownField",
220	                f"unknown field '{node.name}' on type '{info.name}'",
221	            )
222	        type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
223	        if self.schema.is_leaf(type_name):
224	            return 1
225	        target_info = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
226	        if target_info is None:
227	            raise PlanError(
228	                "UnknownField",
229	                f"field '{node.name}' has unsupported type '{type_name}'",
230	            )
231	        if node.selection_set is None:
232	            raise PlanError(
233	                "InvalidQuery", f"field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
234	            )
235	        inner = self._walk_set(node.selection_set, target_info, stack)
236	        if _is_list_type(field.type_ref):
237	            inner *= self._bound_for(node)
238	        return inner
239	
240	
241	def enforce_complexity(
242	    schema: Schema,
243	    variables: Dict[str, Any],
244	    query_text: str,
245	    source: str,
246	    operation_name: Optional[str],
247	    select_operation: Callable,
248	    limit: int,
249	) -> int:
250	    """Re-parse the document, select the operation and enforce the limit.
251	
252	    Invoked only after the command's own compiler has validated the document,
253	    so any GraphQL/variable/mapping error has already surfaced with its
254	    existing code. Raises QueryComplexityExceeded when the score is strictly
255	    above ``limit``; returns the score otherwise.
256	    """
257	    operations, fragments = parse_executable(query_text, source)
258	    op = select_operation(operations, operation_name)
259	    calculator = ComplexityCalculator(schema, variables)
260	    complexity = calculator.score_operation(op, fragments)
261	    if complexity > limit:
262	        raise QueryComplexityExceeded(complexity, limit)
263	    return complexity

1	"""Query plan builder.
2	
3	Turns an executable GraphQL document plus resolved variables into a scan/join
4	plan over the entities declared in the schema. All validation failures raise
5	PlanError with the appropriate code; no partial plan is produced.
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
11	
12	from .errors import PlanError
13	from .gql import (
14	    FieldNode,
15	    FragmentSpread,
16	    InlineFragment,
17	    Var,
18	    parse_executable,
19	)
20	from .schema import Schema, TypeInfo, named_of
21	
22	# Field arguments accepted as list-size bounds while query complexity control
23	# is enabled, in priority order. Only present when a bound limit is configured,
24	# so baseline argument validation is unchanged when the control is off.
25	BOUND_ARG_NAMES = ("first", "limit")
26	
27	
28	def _is_list_type(type_ref) -> bool:
29	    """Whether a (possibly non-null wrapped) field type is a list."""
30	    if type_ref[0] == "non_null":
31	        type_ref = type_ref[1]
32	    return type_ref[0] == "list"
33	
34	
35	class Planner:
36	    def __init__(self, schema: Schema, variables: Dict[str, Any],
37	                 bound_args_allowed: bool = False):
38	        self.schema = schema
39	        self.variables = variables
40	        # When a complexity limit is configured, list fields accept first/limit
41	        # bounds (literal or variable); otherwise arguments stay unsupported.
42	        self.bound_args_allowed = bound_args_allowed
43	        self.fragments: Dict[str, Any] = {}
44	        self.var_map: Dict[str, tuple] = {}
45	        self.joins: List[dict] = []
46	
47	    # -- complexity bound arguments ------------------------------------------
48	
49	    def _accepts_bound_arg(self, is_list_field: bool, arg_name: str) -> bool:
50	        """Whether a first/limit argument is accepted on this field.
51	
52	        Bound arguments are only recognized while complexity control is
53	        enabled and only on list-returning fields; everywhere else the field's
54	        ordinary argument validation (unknown argument / arguments not
55	        supported) keeps applying, so baseline behavior is unchanged.
56	        """
57	        return (
58	            self.bound_args_allowed
59	            and is_list_field
60	            and arg_name in BOUND_ARG_NAMES
61	        )
62	
63	    # -- entry point ---------------------------------------------------------
64	
65	    def plan(self, query_text: str, source: str, operation_name: Optional[str]) -> dict:
66	        operations, self.fragments = parse_executable(query_text, source)
67	        op = self._select_operation(operations, operation_name)
68	        self.var_map = {}
69	        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
70	            if name in self.var_map:
71	                raise PlanError("VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once")
72	            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)
73	
74	        root_type_name = self.schema.roots.get(op.op_type)
75	        root_type = self.schema.types.get(root_type_name) if root_type_name else None
76	        if root_type is None:
77	            raise PlanError(
78	                "UnknownField",
79	                f"schema does not define a root type for {op.op_type} operations",
80	            )
81	
82	        selections = self._expand(op.selection_set, root_type.name, [])
83	        if not selections:
84	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "operation has an empty selection set")
85	
86	        plan = {
87	            "operationType": op.op_type,
88	            "operationName": op.name,
89	            "roots": [],
90	            "joins": self.joins,
91	        }
92	        for node in selections:
93	            plan["roots"].append(self._plan_root(node, root_type))
94	        return plan
95	
96	    # -- operation selection ---------------------------------------------------
97	
98	    @staticmethod
99	    def _select_operation(operations, operation_name):
100	        if operation_name is not None:
101	            for op in operations:
102	                if op.name == operation_name:
103	                    if op.op_type == "subscription":
104	                        raise PlanError(
105	                            "UnsupportedOperation",
106	                            "subscription operations are not supported",
107	                        )
108	                    return op
109	            raise PlanError("InvalidOperation", f"no operation named '{operation_name}'")
110	        candidates = [op for op in operations if op.op_type in ("query", "mutation")]
111	        if len(candidates) == 1:
112	            return candidates[0]
113	        if not operations:
114	            raise PlanError("InvalidRequest", "document contains no operations")
115	        if not candidates and len(operations) == 1:
116	            raise PlanError(
117	                "UnsupportedOperation", "subscription operations are not supported"
118	            )
119	        raise PlanError(
120	            "InvalidRequest",
121	            "multiple operations found; select one with --operation",
122	        )
123	
124	    # -- fragment expansion ------------------------------------------------------
125	
126	    def _type_condition_matches(self, condition: str, type_name: str) -> bool:
127	        if condition == type_name:
128	            return True
129	        info = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
130	        if info is not None and condition in info.interfaces:
131	            return True
132	        members = self.schema.unions.get(condition)
133	        return bool(members) and type_name in members
134	
135	    def _expand(self, selections, type_name: str, stack: List[str]) -> List[FieldNode]:
136	        """Inline fragments and merge fields by response key, preserving order."""
137	        out: List[FieldNode] = []
138	        index: Dict[str, FieldNode] = {}
139	
140	        def add(node: FieldNode) -> None:
141	            key = node.alias or node.name
142	            existing = index.get(key)
143	            if existing is None:
144	                index[key] = FieldNode(
145	                    node.name,
146	                    node.alias,
147	                    dict(node.args),
148	                    list(node.selection_set) if node.selection_set is not None else None,
149	                )
150	                out.append(index[key])
151	                return
152	            if existing.name != node.name:
153	                raise PlanError(
154	                    "InvalidQuery",
155	                    f"conflicting fields '{existing.name}' and '{node.name}' share response key '{key}'",
156	                )
157	            if (existing.selection_set is None) != (node.selection_set is None):
158	                raise PlanError(
159	                    "InvalidQuery", f"conflicting selections for response key '{key}'"
160	                )
161	            if existing.selection_set is not None:
162	                existing.selection_set.extend(node.selection_set)
163	
164	        for sel in selections:
165	            if isinstance(sel, FieldNode):
166	                add(sel)
167	            elif isinstance(sel, FragmentSpread):
168	                frag = self.fragments.get(sel.name)
169	                if frag is None:
170	                    raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", f"unknown fragment '{sel.name}'")
171	                if sel.name in stack:
172	                    raise PlanError(
173	                        "InvalidQuery", f"fragment cycle involving '{sel.name}'"
174	                    )
175	                if self._type_condition_matches(frag.type_condition, type_name):
176	                    for node in self._expand(frag.selection_set, type_name, stack + [sel.name]):
177	                        add(node)
178	            elif isinstance(sel, InlineFragment):
179	                if sel.type_condition is None or self._type_condition_matches(
180	                    sel.type_condition, type_name
181	                ):
182	                    for node in self._expand(sel.selection_set, type_name, stack):
183	                        add(node)
184	        return out
185	
186	    # -- variables ------------------------------------------------------------
187	
188	    def _resolve(self, value: Any) -> Any:
189	        if isinstance(value, Var):
190	            name = value.name
191	            if name not in self.var_map:
192	                raise PlanError(
193	                    "VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is not declared by the operation"
194	                )
195	            type_ref, default, has_default = self.var_map[name]
196	            if name in self.variables:
197	                provided = self.variables[name]
198	                if not self._check_type(type_ref, provided):
199	                    raise PlanError(
200	                        "VariablesError",
201	                        f"variable '${name}' has a value of the wrong type",
202	                    )
203	                return provided
204	            if has_default:
205	                return default
206	            raise PlanError("VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' was not provided")
207	        if isinstance(value, list):
208	            return [self._resolve(item) for item in value]
209	        if isinstance(value, dict):
210	            return {key: self._resolve(item) for key, item in value.items()}
211	        return value
212	
213	    def _check_type(self, type_ref, value) -> bool:
214	        kind = type_ref[0]
215	        if kind == "non_null":
216	            return value is not None and self._check_type(type_ref[1], value)
217	        if value is None:
218	            return True
219	        if kind == "list":
220	            return isinstance(value, list) and all(
221	                self._check_type(type_ref[1], item) for item in value
222	            )
223	        name = type_ref[1]
224	        if name == "Int":
225	            return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
226	        if name == "Float":
227	            return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
228	        if name == "String":
229	            return isinstance(value, str)
230	        if name == "Boolean":
231	            return isinstance(value, bool)
232	        if name == "ID":
233	            return isinstance(value, (str, int)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
234	        if name in self.schema.scalars:
235	            return True
236	        if name in self.schema.enums:
237	            return isinstance(value, str)
238	        input_def = self.schema.inputs.get(name)
239	        if input_def is not None:
240	            if not isinstance(value, dict):
241	                return False
242	            for field_name, field_def in input_def.items():
243	                if (
244	                    field_def.type[0] == "non_null"
245	                    and not field_def.has_default
246	                    and field_name not in value
247	                ):
248	                    return False
249	                if field_name in value and not self._check_type(
250	                    field_def.type, value[field_name]
251	                ):
252	                    return False
253	            return True
254	        return True  # unknown named type: accept
255	
256	    # -- roots ------------------------------------------------------------------
257	
258	    def _plan_root(self, node: FieldNode, root_type: TypeInfo) -> dict:
259	        key = node.alias or node.name
260	        field = root_type.fields.get(node.name)
261	        if field is None:
262	            raise PlanError(
263	                "UnknownField", f"unknown root field '{node.name}' on type '{root_type.name}'"
264	            )
265	        type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
266	        target = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
267	        entity = target.entity if target is not None else None
268	        if entity is None:
269	            raise PlanError(
270	                "UnknownEntity",
271	                f"root field '{node.name}' does not return a mapped entity type",
272	            )
273	        if node.selection_set is None:
274	            raise PlanError(
275	                "InvalidQuery", f"root field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
276	            )
277	        for arg_name, arg_def in field.args.items():
278	            if (
279	                arg_def.type[0] == "non_null"
280	                and not arg_def.has_default
281	                and arg_name not in node.args
282	            ):
283	                raise PlanError(
284	                    "UnknownField",
285	                    f"missing required argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
286	                )
287	        filter_obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
288	        for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
289	            if arg_name not in field.args:
290	                raise PlanError(
291	                    "UnknownField",
292	                    f"unknown argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
293	                )
294	            target_field = target.fields.get(arg_name)
295	            if target_field is None or not self.schema.is_leaf(
296	                named_of(target_field.type_ref)
297	            ):
298	                raise PlanError(
299	                    "UnknownField",
300	                    f"argument '{arg_name}' does not match a filterable field of entity '{entity.table}'",
301	                )
302	            filter_obj[arg_name] = self._resolve(value)
303	        entry = {"path": key, "entity": entity.table, "filter": filter_obj, "fields": []}
304	        self._walk(target, entity, node.selection_set, key, entry)
305	        return entry
306	
307	    # -- nested selections --------------------------------------------------------
308	
309	    def _walk(self, info: TypeInfo, entity, selection_set, path: str, entry: dict) -> None:
310	        selections = self._expand(selection_set, info.name, [])
311	        if not selections:
312	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", f"empty selection set at '{path}'")
313	        for node in selections:
314	            key = node.alias or node.name
315	            node_path = f"{path}.{key}"
316	            field = info.fields.get(node.name)
317	            if field is None:
318	                raise PlanError(
319	                    "UnknownField", f"unknown field '{node.name}' on type '{info.name}'"
320	                )
321	            type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
322	            if self.schema.is_leaf(type_name):
323	                if node.selection_set is not None:
324	                    raise PlanError(
325	                        "InvalidQuery",
326	                        f"scalar field '{node.name}' must not have a selection set",
327	                    )
328	                if node.args:
329	                    raise PlanError(
330	                        "InvalidQuery",
331	                        f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
332	                    )
333	                if node_path not in entry["fields"]:
334	                    entry["fields"].append(node_path)
335	                continue
336	            target = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
337	            if target is None:
338	                raise PlanError(
339	                    "UnknownField",
340	                    f"field '{node.name}' has unsupported type '{type_name}'",
341	                )
342	            if node.args:
343	                raise PlanError(
344	                    "InvalidQuery",
345	                    f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
346	                )
347	            if node.selection_set is None:
348	                raise PlanError(
349	                    "InvalidQuery", f"field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
350	                )
351	            if field.link is None:
352	                raise PlanError(
353	                    "MappingError",
354	                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' is missing an @link directive",
355	                )
356	            target_entity = target.entity
357	            if target_entity is None:
358	                raise PlanError(
359	                    "UnknownEntity",
360	                    f"type '{target.name}' is not mapped to an entity",
361	                )
362	            local, target_key, as_array = field.link
363	            if target_key != target_entity.key:
364	                raise PlanError(
365	                    "InvalidJoin",
366	                    f"@link target {target_key} does not match the primary key of entity '{target_entity.table}'",
367	                )
368	            self.joins.append(
369	                {
370	                    "path": node_path,
371	                    "fromEntity": entity.table,
372	                    "fromField": local if as_array else local[0],

"""graph-index command line interface."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys

from .complexity import (
    QueryComplexityExceeded,
    complexity_error_payload,
    enforce_complexity,
    load_limit_from_env,
)
from .errors import PlanError
from .executor import ExecContext, QueryCompiler, execute, fold_events
from .planner import Planner
from .schema import load_schema
from .subscription import SubscriptionCompiler, push_events


def _read_text_file(path: str) -> str:
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as handle:
            data = handle.read()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise PlanError("IoError", f"cannot read '{path}': {exc.strerror or exc}")
    try:
        return data.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        raise PlanError("IoError", f"'{path}' is not valid UTF-8")


def _load_variables(variables_text: str, source: str) -> dict:
    try:
        variables = json.loads(variables_text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise PlanError(
            "ParseError",
            f"{source}:{exc.lineno}:{exc.colno}: invalid JSON: {exc.msg}",
        )
    if not isinstance(variables, dict):
        raise PlanError("VariablesError", f"'{source}' must contain a JSON object")
    return variables


def _cmd_query_plan(args) -> dict:
    schema_text = _read_text_file(args.schema)
    query_text = _read_text_file(args.query)
    variables_text = _read_text_file(args.variables)

    schema = load_schema(schema_text, args.schema)
    variables = _load_variables(variables_text, args.variables)

    planner = Planner(schema, variables)
    return planner.plan(query_text, args.query, args.operation)


def _cmd_subscription_push(args, complexity_limit) -> list:
    schema_text = _read_text_file(args.schema)
    subscription_text = _read_text_file(args.subscription)
    variables_text = _read_text_file(args.variables)
    events_text = _read_text_file(args.events)

    schema = load_schema(schema_text, args.schema)
    variables = _load_variables(variables_text, args.variables)

    compiler = SubscriptionCompiler(
        schema, variables, bound_args_allowed=complexity_limit is not None
    )
    plan = compiler.compile(subscription_text, args.subscription, args.operation)
    if complexity_limit is not None:
        # Gate before any subscription is established or event is processed.
        enforce_complexity(
            schema,
            variables,
            subscription_text,
            args.subscription,
            args.operation,
            SubscriptionCompiler._select_operation,
            complexity_limit,
        )
    return push_events(plan, events_text, args.events)


def _cmd_query_exec(args, complexity_limit) -> dict:
    schema_text = _read_text_file(args.schema)
    query_text = _read_text_file(args.query)
    variables_text = _read_text_file(args.variables)
    events_text = _read_text_file(args.events)

    schema = load_schema(schema_text, args.schema)
    variables = _load_variables(variables_text, args.variables)

    compiler = QueryCompiler(
        schema, variables, bound_args_allowed=complexity_limit is not None
    )
    _operation_name, roots = compiler.compile(
        query_text, args.query, args.operation
    )
    if complexity_limit is not None:
        # Gate after the document/variables have passed ordinary validation but
        # before any indexed entity is read (events are folded only afterwards).
        enforce_complexity(
            schema,
            variables,
            query_text,
            args.query,
            args.operation,
            QueryCompiler._select_operation,
            complexity_limit,
        )
    ctx = ExecContext(schema, compiler.entity_keys, compiler.key_types)
    fold_events(ctx, events_text, args.events)
    return execute(roots, ctx)


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="graph-index",
        description="Blockchain data index and GraphQL query service tooling.",
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    query_plan = sub.add_parser(
        "query-plan", help="compile a GraphQL query into an entity scan/join plan"
    )
    query_plan.add_argument("--schema", required=True, help="GraphQL schema file (SDL)")
    query_plan.add_argument("--query", required=True, help="GraphQL query file")
    query_plan.add_argument("--variables", required=True, help="variables JSON file")
    query_plan.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        default=None,
        help="operation name to select when the document has several",
    )
    subscription_push = sub.add_parser(
        "subscription-push",
        help="push entity change events matching a GraphQL subscription as JSONL",
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--schema", required=True, help="GraphQL schema file (SDL)"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--subscription", required=True, help="GraphQL subscription file"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--variables", required=True, help="variables JSON file"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--events", required=True, help="entity change events file (NDJSON)"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        default=None,
        help="operation name to select when the document has several",
    )
    query_exec = sub.add_parser(
        "query-exec",
        help="execute a GraphQL query over entity change events",
    )
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--schema", required=True, help="GraphQL schema file (SDL)"
    )
    query_exec.add_argument("--query", required=True, help="GraphQL query file")
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--variables", required=True, help="variables JSON file"
    )
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--events", required=True, help="entity change events file (NDJSON)"
    )
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        default=None,
        help="operation name to select when the document has several",
    )
    return parser


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        # Read and validate the complexity limit at startup, before the command
        # opens anything: an invalid value fails with the unique diagnostic
        # code INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT. Absent/0 disables the control.
        complexity_limit = load_limit_from_env()
    except PlanError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(
            json.dumps({"code": exc.code, "message": exc.message}, ensure_ascii=False)
            + "\n"
        )
        return 2
    try:
        if args.command == "query-plan":
            result = _cmd_query_plan(args)
            sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
            return 0
        if args.command == "subscription-push":
            try:
                rows = _cmd_subscription_push(args, complexity_limit)
            except QueryComplexityExceeded as exc:
                sys.stdout.write(
                    json.dumps(
                        complexity_error_payload(exc.complexity, exc.limit),
                        ensure_ascii=False,
                        indent=2,
                    )
                    + "\n"
                )
                return 0
            for row in rows:
                sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            return 0
        if args.command == "query-exec":
            try:
                result = _cmd_query_exec(args, complexity_limit)
            except QueryComplexityExceeded as exc:
                # Deterministic stop: data is null and the single error carries
                # QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED; no resolver ran and no entity was
                # read, so the response is still a normal GraphQL success exit.
                result = complexity_error_payload(exc.complexity, exc.limit)
            sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
            return 0
        raise PlanError("InvalidRequest", f"unknown command '{args.command}'")
    except PlanError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(
            json.dumps({"code": exc.code, "message": exc.message}, ensure_ascii=False)
            + "\n"
        )
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":  # pragma: no cover
    raise SystemExit(main())

1	"""Subscription push: match entity change events against a subscription.
2	
3	Compiles a subscription operation into an equality filter plus a field
4	projection over a single @entity root, then applies it to an NDJSON stream of
5	entity change events. GraphQL, variable and @entity mapping semantics are
6	shared with the query planner; the supported selection shape covers leaf
7	fields, nested object fields and nested list fields reached through @link
8	joins (one or more levels deep, including aliases and fragment spreads).
9	
10	List fields match every current target snapshot whose @link target field
11	values equal the source's local field values; the matched targets are
12	recursively projected in target insert order. The @link target of a list
13	relationship need not be (part of) the target entity's primary key.
14	"""
15	
16	from __future__ import annotations
17	
18	import json
19	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
20	
21	from .errors import PlanError
22	from .gql import Var, parse_executable
23	from .planner import Planner, _is_list_type
24	from .schema import Entity, TypeInfo, named_of
25	
26	EVENT_OPS = ("INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE")
27	
28	_MISSING = object()
29	
30	
31	class SubscriptionPlan:
32	    """A compiled subscription ready to filter and project event snapshots."""
33	
34	    __slots__ = (
35	        "operation_name",
36	        "path",
37	        "entity_table",
38	        "entity_keys",
39	        "filter",
40	        "tree",
41	    )
42	
43	    def __init__(
44	        self,
45	        operation_name: Optional[str],
46	        path: str,
47	        entity_table: str,
48	        entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
49	        filter_obj: Dict[str, Any],
50	        tree: "LinkedField",
51	    ):
52	        self.operation_name = operation_name
53	        self.path = path
54	        self.entity_table = entity_table
55	        # entity table -> primary key field names, in declared order, for the
56	        # root entity and every entity reachable through selected @link fields
57	        self.entity_keys = entity_keys
58	        self.filter = filter_obj  # entity field name -> expected value
59	        self.tree = tree  # compiled selection tree rooted at the root field
60	
61	    def matches(self, snapshot: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
62	        for name, expected in self.filter.items():
63	            if name not in snapshot:
64	                raise PlanError(
65	                    "EventError", f"snapshot is missing filter field '{name}'"
66	                )
67	            if snapshot[name] != expected:
68	                return False
69	        return True
70	
71	
72	class LinkedField:
73	    """A compiled field in the subscription selection tree.
74	
75	    Leaf fields carry ``field_name`` and no children. Link fields carry the
76	    validated @link mapping (local/target field names, target entity) and a
77	    list of compiled children; ``is_list`` selects list (ordered, possibly
78	    many) rather than single-object resolution.
79	    """
80	
81	    __slots__ = (
82	        "response_key",
83	        "field_name",
84	        "required",
85	        "is_list",
86	        "local",
87	        "target",
88	        "target_table",
89	        "children",
90	    )
91	
92	    def __init__(
93	        self,
94	        response_key: str,
95	        field_name: str,
96	        required: bool = False,
97	        is_list: bool = False,
98	        local: Optional[List[str]] = None,
99	        target: Optional[List[str]] = None,
100	        target_table: Optional[str] = None,
101	        children: Optional[List["LinkedField"]] = None,
102	    ):
103	        self.response_key = response_key
104	        self.field_name = field_name
105	        self.required = required  # field declared as a non-null object type
106	        self.is_list = is_list
107	        self.local = local  # source-side key field names, in @link order
108	        self.target = target  # target-side matched field names, in @link order
109	        self.target_table = target_table
110	        self.children = children
111	
112	
113	class SubscriptionCompiler(Planner):
114	    """Reuses the planner's fragment expansion and variable resolution."""
115	
116	    def __init__(self, schema, variables, bound_args_allowed: bool = False):
117	        super().__init__(schema, variables, bound_args_allowed)
118	
119	    def compile(
120	        self, subscription_text: str, source: str, operation_name: Optional[str]
121	    ) -> SubscriptionPlan:
122	        operations, self.fragments = parse_executable(subscription_text, source)
123	        op = self._select_operation(operations, operation_name)
124	        self.var_map = {}
125	        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
126	            if name in self.var_map:

128	                    "VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once"
129	                )
130	            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)
131

133	        root_type = self.schema.types.get(root_type_name) if root_type_name else None
134	        if root_type is None:

138	            )

141	        if not selections:

169	        filter_obj = self._compile_filter(field, target, entity.table, node)
170	        entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]] = {entity.table: list(entity.key)}
171	        children = self._compile_fields(
172	            target, entity, node.selection_set, key, entity_keys
173	        )
174	        tree = LinkedField(key, key, children=children)
175	        return SubscriptionPlan(
176	            op.name, key, entity.table, entity_keys, filter_obj, tree
177	        )
178	
179	    # -- operation selection ---------------------------------------------------
180	
181	    @staticmethod
182	    def _select_operation(operations, operation_name):
183	        if operation_name is not None:
184	            for op in operations:
185	                if op.name == operation_name and op.op_type == "subscription":
186	                    return op
187	            raise PlanError(
188	                "InvalidQuery", f"no subscription named '{operation_name}'"
189	            )
190	        if not operations:
191	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "document contains no operations")
192	        if len(operations) != 1:
193	            raise PlanError(
194	                "InvalidQuery",
195	                "multiple operations found; select one with --operation",
196	            )
197	        op = operations[0]
198	        if op.op_type != "subscription":
199	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "operation must be a subscription")
200	        return op
201	
202	    # -- filter ------------------------------------------------------------------
203	
204	    def _compile_filter(self, field, target, table, node) -> Dict[str, Any]:
205	        for arg_name, arg_def in field.args.items():
206	            if (
207	                arg_def.type[0] == "non_null"
208	                and not arg_def.has_default
209	                and arg_name not in node.args
210	            ):
211	                raise PlanError(
212	                    "InvalidQuery",
213	                    f"missing required argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
214	                )
215	        is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
216	        filter_obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
217	        for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
218	            if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):
219	                # A list-size bound used for complexity; never a filter. If it
220	                # is a variable, resolve it so type/required-variable errors
221	                # are reported by the normal validation phase.
222	                if isinstance(value, Var):
223	                    self._resolve(value)
224	                continue
225	            if arg_name not in field.args:
226	                raise PlanError(
227	                    "InvalidQuery",
228	                    f"unknown argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
229	                )
230	            target_field = target.fields.get(arg_name)
231	            if target_field is None or not self.schema.is_leaf(
232	                named_of(target_field.type_ref)
233	            ):
234	                raise PlanError(
235	                    "InvalidQuery",
236	                    f"argument '{arg_name}' does not match a filterable field of entity '{table}'",
237	                )
238	            filter_obj[arg_name] = self._resolve(value)
239	        return filter_obj
240	
241	    # -- selection tree -----------------------------------------------------------
242	
243	    def _compile_fields(
244	        self,
245	        info: TypeInfo,
246	        entity: Entity,
247	        selection_set,
248	        path: str,
249	        entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
250	    ) -> List[LinkedField]:
251	        selections = self._expand(selection_set, info.name, [])
252	        if not selections:
253	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", f"empty selection set at '{path}'")
254	        children: List[LinkedField] = []
255	        seen = set()
256	        for node in selections:
257	            key = node.alias or node.name
258	            node_path = f"{path}.{key}"
259	            field = info.fields.get(node.name)
260	            if field is None:
261	                raise PlanError(
262	                    "InvalidQuery",
263	                    f"unknown field '{node.name}' on type '{info.name}'",
264	                )
265	            type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
266	            if self.schema.is_leaf(type_name):
267	                if node.selection_set is not None:
268	                    raise PlanError(
269	                        "InvalidQuery",
270	                        f"scalar field '{node.name}' must not have a selection set",
271	                    )
272	                if node.args:
273	                    raise PlanError(
274	                        "InvalidQuery",
275	                        f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
276	                    )
277	                if key not in seen:
278	                    seen.add(key)
279	                    children.append(LinkedField(key, node.name))
280	                continue
281	            is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
282	            for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
283	                if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):
284	                    if isinstance(value, Var):
285	                        self._resolve(value)
286	                    continue
287	                raise PlanError(
288	                    "InvalidQuery",
289	                    f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
290	                )
291	            if node.selection_set is None:
292	                raise PlanError(
293	                    "InvalidQuery", f"field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
294	                )
295	            required = field.type_ref[0] == "non_null"
296	            if field.link is None:
297	                raise PlanError(
298	                    "MappingError",
299	                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' is missing an @link directive",
300	                )
301	            target_info = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
302	            if target_info is None:
303	                raise PlanError(
304	                    "MappingError",
305	                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' has unsupported type '{type_name}'",
306	                )
307	            target_entity = target_info.entity
308	            if target_entity is None:
309	                raise PlanError(
310	                    "UnknownEntity",
311	                    f"type '{target_info.name}' is not mapped to an entity",
312	                )
313	            local, target_key, _as_array = field.link
314	            if is_list:
315	                # A list relationship matches equality on arbitrary scalar
316	                # target fields (they need not form the target primary key),
317	                # so every matched field must hold a single scalar value.
318	                for name in local:
319	                    matched_local = info.fields.get(name)
320	                    if not _is_scalar_value_field(self.schema, matched_local):
321	                        raise PlanError(
322	                            "MappingError",
323	                            f"@link local field '{name}' of type '{info.name}' "
324	                            f"must be a scalar",
325	                        )
326	                for name in target_key:
327	                    matched = target_info.fields.get(name)
328	                    if matched is None:
329	                        raise PlanError(
330	                            "MappingError",
331	                            f"@link target field '{name}' is not a field of type "
332	                            f"'{target_info.name}'",
333	                        )
334	                    if not _is_scalar_value_field(self.schema, matched):
335	                        raise PlanError(
336	                            "MappingError",
337	                            f"@link target field '{name}' of type "
338	                            f"'{target_info.name}' must be a scalar",
339	                        )
340	            elif target_key != target_entity.key:
341	                raise PlanError(
342	                    "InvalidJoin",
343	                    f"@link target {target_key} does not match the primary key of "
344	                    f"entity '{target_entity.table}'",
345	                )
346	            nested = self._compile_fields(
347	                target_info,
348	                target_entity,
349	                node.selection_set,
350	                node_path,
351	                entity_keys,
352	            )
353	            if key not in seen:
354	                seen.add(key)
355	                entity_keys[target_entity.table] = list(target_entity.key)
356	                children.append(
357	                    LinkedField(
358	                        key,
359	                        node.name,
360	                        required=required,
361	                        is_list=is_list,
362	                        local=list(local),
363	                        target=list(target_key),
364	                        target_table=target_entity.table,
365	                        children=nested,
366	                    )
367	                )
368	        return children
369	
370	
371	def _is_scalar_value_field(schema, field) -> bool:
372	    """Whether a field holds a single (non-list) built-in/custom scalar."""
373	    if field is None:
374	        return False
375	    return (
376	        not _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
377	        and named_of(field.type_ref) in schema.scalars
378	    )
379	
380	
381	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
382	# Event processing
383	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
384	
385	
386	class _OrderedStore:
387	    """Latest snapshots of one entity, kept in insert order.
388	
389	    INSERT introduces a new row at the end; UPDATE replaces a row in place and
390	    preserves its position; DELETE removes a row, so a later re-INSERT is
391	    appended at the end again. Snapshots whose primary key cannot be built
392	    cannot participate in keyed identity (and therefore cannot be deleted by
393	    key); they are retained separately so a list match on non-key target
394	    fields can surface them as an EventError instead of silently dropping them.
395	    """
396	
397	    __slots__ = ("rows", "keyless")
398	
399	    def __init__(self):
400	        self.rows: Dict[Tuple[Any, ...], Dict[str, Any]] = {}
401	        self.keyless: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
402	
403	    def upsert(self, key: Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]], snapshot: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
404	        # Dict assignment appends a new key at the end and replaces an existing
405	        # key's value without moving it, which is exactly the required order.
406	        if key is None:
407	            self.keyless.append(snapshot)
408	        else:
409	            self.rows[key] = snapshot
410	
411	    def delete(self, key: Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]]) -> None:
412	        # A keyed row is removed so a later upsert re-appends it at the end; a
413	        # keyless DELETE cannot identify a stored row and leaves them untouched.
414	        if key is not None:
415	            self.rows.pop(key, None)
416	
417	    def values(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
418	        return list(self.rows.values())
419	
420	
421	def push_events(
422	    plan: SubscriptionPlan, events_text: str, source: str
423	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
424	    """Apply a compiled subscription to an NDJSON event stream, in order.
425	
426	    Every line is parsed and validated first; the latest snapshot of each
427	    entity is then maintained by primary key, and matching root events are
428	    projected against the snapshots known up to and including that line.
429	    """
430	    events: List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]] = []
431	    for lineno, raw in enumerate(events_text.splitlines(), 1):
432	        line = raw.strip()
433	        if not line:
434	            continue
435	        events.append((lineno, _parse_event(line, source, lineno)))
436	
437	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore] = {}
438	    outputs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
439	    for lineno, event in events:
440	        _apply_event(plan.entity_keys, snapshots, event)
441	        if event["entity"] != plan.entity_table:
442	            continue
443	        op = event["op"]
444	        snapshot = event["after"] if op in ("INSERT", "UPDATE") else event["before"]
445	        if snapshot is None:
446	            raise PlanError(
447	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: {op} event has no snapshot"
448	            )
449	        if not plan.matches(snapshot):
450	            continue
451	        data = _project(
452	            plan.tree.children,
453	            snapshot,
454	            snapshots,
455	            plan.entity_keys,
456	            source,
457	            lineno,
458	            plan.path,
459	        )
460	        outputs.append(
461	            {
462	                "subscription": plan.operation_name,
463	                "path": plan.path,
464	                "event": op,
465	                "entity": event["entity"],
466	                "data": data,
467	            }
468	        )
469	    return outputs
470	
471	
472	def _apply_event(
473	    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
474	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
475	    event: Dict[str, Any],
476	) -> None:
477	    """Update the latest-snapshot store for one validated event.
478	
479	    Events for entities the subscription cannot reach are ignored. Rows whose
480	    snapshot lacks a usable primary key cannot identify an entity; they are
481	    skipped here and surface as an EventError when a matching root event tries
482	    to traverse the relationship, rather than at their own line.
483	    """
484	    key_fields = entity_keys.get(event["entity"])
485	    if key_fields is None:
486	        return
487	    store = snapshots.setdefault(event["entity"], _OrderedStore())
488	    if event["op"] in ("INSERT", "UPDATE"):
489	        snapshot = event["after"]
490	        if snapshot is not None:
491	            store.upsert(_key_tuple(key_fields, snapshot), snapshot)
492	        return
493	    snapshot = event["before"]
494	    if snapshot is not None:
495	        store.delete(_key_tuple(key_fields, snapshot))
496	
497	
498	def _key_tuple(
499	    key_fields: List[str], snapshot: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
500	) -> Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]]:
501	    """Build a primary-key tuple, or None when the snapshot cannot supply one."""
502	    if not isinstance(snapshot, dict):
503	        return None
504	    values: List[Any] = []
505	    for name in key_fields:
506	        value = snapshot.get(name)
507	        if value is None or isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
508	            return None
509	        values.append(value)
510	    return tuple(values)
511	
512	
513	def _project(
514	    nodes: List[LinkedField],
515	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
516	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
517	    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
518	    source: str,
519	    lineno: int,
520	    path: str,
521	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
522	    """Project compiled selections over one entity snapshot."""
523	    data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
524	    for node in nodes:
525	        node_path = f"{path}.{node.response_key}"
526	        if node.children is None:
527	            if node.field_name not in snapshot:
528	                raise PlanError(
529	                    "EventError",
530	                    f"{source}:{lineno}: snapshot is missing field "
531	                    f"'{node.field_name}'",
532	                )
533	            data[node.response_key] = snapshot[node.field_name]
534	            continue
535	        if node.is_list:
536	            data[node.response_key] = _project_list(
537	                node, snapshot, snapshots, entity_keys, source, lineno, node_path
538	            )
539	            continue
540	        related = _resolve_object(node, snapshot, snapshots, source, lineno, node_path)
541	        if related is None:
542	            if node.required:
543	                raise PlanError(
544	                    "EventError",
545	                    f"{source}:{lineno}: non-null relationship '{node_path}' "
546	                    f"resolved to null",
547	                )
548	            data[node.response_key] = None
549	        else:
550	            data[node.response_key] = _project(
551	                node.children,
552	                related,
553	                snapshots,
554	                entity_keys,
555	                source,
556	                lineno,
557	                node_path,
558	            )
559	    return data
560	
561	
562	def _project_list(
563	    node: LinkedField,
564	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
565	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
566	    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
567	    source: str,
568	    lineno: int,
569	    path: str,
570	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
571	    """Resolve a list @link and project each matched target snapshot."""
572	    matches = _resolve_list(
573	        node, snapshot, snapshots, entity_keys, source, lineno, path
574	    )
575	    return [
576	        _project(
577	            node.children,
578	            related,
579	            snapshots,
580	            entity_keys,
581	            source,
582	            lineno,
583	            path,
584	        )
585	        for related in matches
586	    ]
587	
588	
589	def _read_local(
590	    node: LinkedField,
591	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
592	    source: str,
593	    lineno: int,
594	    path: str,
595	) -> Optional[List[Any]]:
596	    """Read the @link local key values from a source snapshot.
597	
598	    Returns None when any local value is null (the relationship itself is
599	    absent). Missing local key fields or values that cannot form a scalar key
600	    end the stream with EventError.
601	    """
602	    local_values: List[Any] = []
603	    for name in node.local:
604	        if name not in snapshot:
605	            raise PlanError(
606	                "EventError",
607	                f"{source}:{lineno}: snapshot is missing local key field "
608	                f"'{name}' for '{path}'",
609	            )
610	        value = snapshot[name]
611	        if value is None:
612	            return None
613	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
614	            raise PlanError(
615	                "EventError",
616	                f"{source}:{lineno}: local key field '{name}' for '{path}' "
617	                f"cannot form a scalar key",
618	            )
619	        local_values.append(value)
620	    return local_values
621	
622	
623	def _check_target_fields(
624	    node: LinkedField,
625	    related: Dict[str, Any],
626	    source: str,
627	    lineno: int,
628	    path: str,
629	) -> None:
630	    """Ensure every matched target field is present (and scalar) on a snapshot."""
631	    for name in node.target:
632	        if name not in related:
633	            raise PlanError(
634	                "EventError",
635	                f"{source}:{lineno}: target snapshot is missing key field "
636	                f"'{name}' for '{path}'",
637	            )
638	        if isinstance(related[name], (dict, list)):
639	            raise PlanError(
640	                "EventError",
641	                f"{source}:{lineno}: target key field '{name}' for '{path}' "
642	                f"cannot be matched as a scalar",
643	            )
644	
645	
646	def _check_primary_key(
647	    table: str,
648	    key_fields: List[str],
649	    related: Dict[str, Any],
650	    source: str,
651	    lineno: int,
652	    path: str,
653	) -> None:
654	    """Ensure a matched target snapshot supplies its scalar primary key."""
655	    for name in key_fields:
656	        if name not in related:
657	            raise PlanError(
658	                "EventError",
659	                f"{source}:{lineno}: target snapshot of entity '{table}' for "
660	                f"'{path}' is missing primary key field '{name}'",
661	            )
662	        if isinstance(related[name], (dict, list)):
663	            raise PlanError(
664	                "EventError",
665	                f"{source}:{lineno}: primary key field '{name}' of entity "
666	                f"'{table}' for '{path}' cannot be a key",
667	            )
668	
669	
670	def _resolve_object(
671	    node: LinkedField,
672	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
673	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
674	    source: str,
675	    lineno: int,
676	    path: str,
677	) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
678	    """Follow one single-object @link to the latest target snapshot.
679	
680	    Returns None when any local key value is null (the relationship itself is
681	    absent). Missing local key fields, values that cannot form the target
682	    primary key or a target key without a current snapshot end the stream with
683	    EventError.
684	    """
685	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, source, lineno, path)
686	    if local_values is None:
687	        return None
688	
689	    target_store = snapshots.get(node.target_table)
690	    related = (
691	        _MISSING
692	        if target_store is None
693	        else target_store.rows.get(tuple(local_values), _MISSING)
694	    )
695	    if related is _MISSING:
696	        rendered = ", ".join(
697	            f"{name}: {json.dumps(value)}"
698	            for name, value in zip(node.target, local_values)
699	        )
700	        raise PlanError(
701	            "EventError",
702	            f"{source}:{lineno}: no current snapshot of entity "
703	            f"'{node.target_table}' for '{path}' with key {{{rendered}}}",
704	        )
705	    _check_target_fields(node, related, source, lineno, path)
706	    return related
707	
708	
709	def _resolve_list(
710	    node: LinkedField,
711	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
712	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
713	    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
714	    source: str,
715	    lineno: int,
716	    path: str,
717	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
718	    """Match all current target snapshots for a list @link, in insert order.
719	
720	    An empty list stands for both an absent relationship (any local value
721	    null) and a relationship without a current match. Local key fields that
722	    are missing or non-scalar, and matched target snapshots that lack a target
723	    field or a usable primary key, end the stream with EventError.
724	    """
725	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, source, lineno, path)
726	    if local_values is None:
727	        return []
728	
729	    target_store = snapshots.get(node.target_table)
730	    if target_store is None:
731	        return []
732	    pk_fields = entity_keys[node.target_table]
733	    expected = tuple(local_values)
734	    matches: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
735	    candidates = list(target_store.rows.values()) + list(target_store.keyless)
736	    for related in candidates:
737	        _check_target_fields(node, related, source, lineno, path)
738	        values = tuple(related[name] for name in node.target)
739	        if values != expected or None in values:
740	            continue
741	        _check_primary_key(
742	            node.target_table, pk_fields, related, source, lineno, path
743	        )
744	        matches.append(related)
745	    return matches
746	
747	
748	def _parse_event(line: str, source: str, lineno: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
749	    try:
750	        event = json.loads(line)
751	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
752	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: invalid JSON: {exc.msg}")
753	    if not isinstance(event, dict):
754	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event must be a JSON object")
755	    for key in ("op", "entity", "before", "after"):
756	        if key not in event:
757	            raise PlanError(
758	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event is missing '{key}'"
759	            )
760	    if event["op"] not in EVENT_OPS:
761	        raise PlanError(
762	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: unknown op {event['op']!r}"
763	        )
764	    if not isinstance(event["entity"], str):
765	        raise PlanError(
766	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: 'entity' must be a string"
767	        )
768	    for key in ("before", "after"):
769	        if event[key] is not None and not isinstance(event[key], dict):
770	            raise PlanError(
771	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: '{key}' must be an object or null"
772	            )
773	    return event

137	    def _write(self, name, content, mode="w"):
138	        path = os.path.join(self.tmp.name, name)
139	        with open(path, mode) as handle:
140	            handle.write(content)
141	        return path

143	    def run_cli(self, query, variables="{}", schema=SCHEMA, events=EVENTS,
144	                operation=None):
145	        schema_path = self._write("schema.graphql", schema)
146	        query_path = self._write("query.graphql", query)
147	        variables_path = self._write("variables.json", variables)
148	        events_path = self._write("events.ndjson", events)
149	        argv = ["query-exec", "--schema", schema_path, "--query", query_path,
150	                "--variables", variables_path, "--events", events_path]
151	        if operation is not None:
152	            argv += ["--operation", operation]
153	        stdout, stderr = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
154	        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(stdout), contextlib.redirect_stderr(stderr):
155	            code = main(argv)
156	        return code, stdout.getvalue(), stderr.getvalue()

158	    def assert_error(self, code, stdout, stderr, expected_code):
159	        self.assertEqual(code, 2, stdout)

163	        self.assertIsInstance(payload["message"], str)
164	        self.assertTrue(payload["message"])

167	        self.assertEqual(stderr, "")
168	        self.assertEqual(code, 0, stderr)
169	        payload = json.loads(stdout)

171	        return payload["data"]
